definition.en: A geographic information system (GIS) is a framework of data, software, methods, and people for capturing, managing, analyzing, and communicating information tied to geographic locations.
definition.zh-Hans: 地理信息系统（GIS）是由空间数据、软件、方法及相关人员共同构成的体系，用于采集、管理、分析和表达与地理位置有关的信息。

plain.zh-Hans: 地图可以告诉你一所学校在哪里；GIS 还能把学校、道路、人口和风险区放在一起，分析“哪里适合建避难所”。它不仅展示位置，更帮助你用位置作判断。
plain.en: A map can show where a school is. GIS can combine schools, roads, population, and hazards to decide where an emergency shelter makes sense.

example.en: A city combines schools, population, roads, and flood zones to evaluate possible locations for an emergency shelter.
example.zh-Hans: 城市将学校、人口、道路和洪水风险区的数据放在一起，分析应急避难所适合建在哪里。

misconception.en: GIS is not simply a map viewer. Data management and spatial analysis are central parts of a GIS workflow.
misconception.zh-Hans: GIS 不等于在线地图或地图浏览器。空间数据管理和分析同样是 GIS 的核心能力。

essence.zh-Hans: 把位置、信息与分析连在一起，用来回答和地点有关的问题。
essence.en: GIS connects places, information, and analysis to answer location-based questions.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 当你需要比较选址、规划路线或理解洪涝风险时，GIS 让许多分散的数据能放在同一空间里分析。
why_it_matters.en: When deciding where to build, how to route, or who faces flood risk, GIS brings different datasets into one spatial analysis.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 地图说：“它在这儿。” GIS 继续问：“所以，这意味着什么？”
fresh_take.en: A map says, “Here it is.” GIS asks, “What does that mean?”

translation_note.zh-Hans: GIS 是系统与方法体系，不应一概译成“地图软件”。
translation_note.en: GIS describes a system and practices, not merely map software.

definition.en: A geographic feature is a representation of an identifiable real-world object or phenomenon with a spatial location and, typically, descriptive attributes.
definition.zh-Hans: 地理要素是对可识别的现实世界对象或现象的地理表达，具有空间位置，并通常包含描述它的属性信息。

plain.zh-Hans: 想象给地图上的每个公园建一份档案：形状和位置告诉你它在哪，名称、面积等信息告诉你它是什么。这个可识别的地图对象就是要素。
plain.en: Think of each park as a record on a map: its shape shows where it is and its attributes tell you more. That mapped object is a feature.

example.en: Each park polygon stores a boundary and a park name; together they describe individual park features.
example.zh-Hans: 公园图层中的每个面要素既有边界，又有公园名称等属性。

misconception.en: A feature is not the same as a layer: a layer may display many features and control how they appear.
misconception.zh-Hans: 一个要素不等于一个图层。一个图层通常可以显示许多要素，并管理它们的显示方式。

essence.zh-Hans: 把现实中的一个对象或现象表达为可定位、可描述的地理对象。
essence.en: A feature represents an identifiable real-world object or phenomenon with location and properties.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 只有把学校、路段等对象区分开，才能逐个查询、统计和更新它们。
why_it_matters.en: Identifying individual schools or road segments lets you query, count, and update them separately.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 现实里的每件事物，进入地图时都领到一个位置和一份档案。
fresh_take.en: Every mapped thing gets a place and a profile.

translation_note.zh-Hans: Feature 在地理信息领域通常译为「要素」；它描述现实或抽象地理对象，不等于其几何 Geometry。
translation_note.en: Feature refers to a geographic object or phenomenon; it is not identical to its geometry.

definition.en: A layer is a map or scene component that references geographic data or another source and defines how it is displayed and used in a particular view.
definition.zh-Hans: 图层是地图或场景中的一个组成部分，引用地理数据或其他数据源，并定义这些内容在特定视图中如何显示和使用。

plain.zh-Hans: 像在透明片上分别画道路、河流和学校，再把透明片叠起来。你可以只开关其中一层，甚至改变它的绘制样式，而不必修改原始数据。
plain.en: Imagine roads, rivers, and schools drawn on separate transparent sheets. You can show, hide, or restyle each sheet without necessarily changing the source data.

example.en: The same road dataset appears as a gray local-road layer in one map and as a colored traffic-priority layer in another.
example.zh-Hans: 同一份道路数据，在一张地图中按道路等级显示，在另一张地图中可以按交通优先级显示。

misconception.en: Removing a layer from a map does not necessarily delete its underlying dataset.
misconception.zh-Hans: 从地图中移除图层，通常不代表删除它所引用的源数据。

essence.zh-Hans: 同一张地图中可单独组织和显示的一组内容。
essence.en: A layer organizes content that a map can display and control independently.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 切换图层可以在同一地区分别观察道路、人口或风险，而不用重做整张地图。
why_it_matters.en: Switch layers to examine roads, population, or risk in the same area without rebuilding the map.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 世界太复杂，一张地图只好让不同的事实分层发言。
fresh_take.en: The world has too many stories; a map lets each layer speak.

translation_note.zh-Hans: ArcGIS 的图层是对数据源的引用及其显示配置，不应当与底层要素类混为一谈。
translation_note.en: An ArcGIS layer references data and display rules; it is distinct from its underlying feature class.

definition.en: Geometry is the spatial shape and position used to represent a feature, commonly as points, lines, or polygons, with coordinates interpreted in a spatial reference.
definition.zh-Hans: 几何是用于表示要素空间形状与位置的数据，常见类型包括点、线和面；其坐标需要结合空间参考才能正确解释。

plain.zh-Hans: 同一个城市里，公交站可以是点，道路可以是线，湖泊可以是面。几何描述这些对象“在哪里、是什么形状”；它们叫什么则通常由属性回答。
plain.en: A bus stop may be a point, a road a line, and a lake a polygon. Geometry answers “where and what shape”; attributes usually answer “what is it called?”.

example.en: A road feature has a polyline geometry recording its route; its road name is stored separately as an attribute.
example.zh-Hans: 一条道路要素使用折线几何记录其路线，而道路名称通常保存在属性字段中。

misconception.en: Coordinates alone do not reveal where a geometry sits on Earth unless their coordinate reference system is known.
misconception.zh-Hans: 只看到一组数字坐标，并不能确定几何在地球上的位置；还需要知道它使用的坐标参考系统。

essence.zh-Hans: 地理对象在空间中的位置与形状。
essence.en: Geometry describes the position and shape of a spatial object.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 判断两条路是否相交、一个点是否落入公园，都离不开几何。
why_it_matters.en: To determine whether roads cross or a point lies inside a park, you need geometry.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 给空间对象画骨架：一个点、一条线，或围起来的一片地。
fresh_take.en: The skeleton of a mapped object: a point, a line, or an enclosed area.

translation_note.zh-Hans: Geometry 在 GIS 数据结构中强调空间形状及坐标，不能替代 Feature 的语义及属性。
translation_note.en: Geometry carries spatial shape and coordinates; a feature also has identity and properties.

definition.en: An attribute is a recorded characteristic of a feature or other data record, commonly represented by a field value in a table.
definition.zh-Hans: 属性是描述要素或其他数据记录某项特征的信息，通常表示为表格字段中的取值。

plain.zh-Hans: 地图上一个点告诉你学校的位置；附在这个点上的信息告诉你名称、学生人数和学校类型。后面这些可查询、可统计的信息，就是属性。
plain.en: A point on a map shows a school’s location; its name, enrollment, and type are attributes you can search or summarize.

example.en: A tree inventory stores species, planting year, and health status as attributes of each mapped tree.
example.zh-Hans: 城市树木清查数据为每一棵树记录树种、种植年份和健康状况等属性。

misconception.en: An attribute is not always text: it may be a number, date, category, or other typed value.
misconception.zh-Hans: 属性不只是文字，还可能是数字、日期、分类代码或其他类型的数据。

essence.zh-Hans: 除了位置与形状之外，用来描述对象的具体信息。
essence.en: Attributes describe an object beyond its location and shape.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 有了属性，地图不只能显示树在哪里，还能筛选生病的树或统计某一树种。
why_it_matters.en: Attributes let you go beyond locating trees to filtering unhealthy ones or counting a species.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 位置负责告诉你“是谁在哪”，属性负责补上“它怎么样”。
fresh_take.en: Location says where; attributes tell the rest of the story.

translation_note.zh-Hans: Attribute 译“属性”，不要误解为只能存放文字。
translation_note.en: Attribute refers to a data property, not just textual descriptions.

definition.en: Vector data represents geographic objects using coordinate-based geometries such as points, lines, and polygons, often with associated attributes.
definition.zh-Hans: 矢量数据通过点、线、面等基于坐标的几何表达地理对象，并且通常可关联属性信息。

plain.zh-Hans: 你要记录“这条路、那块地、这一家店”，可以分别用线、面、点表示，并附上各自的资料。这种一个对象一个对象地表达空间的方式就是矢量数据。
plain.en: To map this road, that parcel, and a particular shop, represent them with lines, polygons, and points, each with its own details: that is vector data.

example.en: A cadastral map stores parcel boundaries as polygons and parcel identifiers as fields.
example.zh-Hans: 地籍图用面要素表示宗地边界，并用属性字段保存宗地编号。

misconception.en: Vector does not automatically mean precise. Its accuracy depends on the source, scale, and collection method.
misconception.zh-Hans: 矢量数据不代表天然精确，其精度仍取决于采集方法、数据来源和制图比例尺。

essence.zh-Hans: 用带坐标的点、线和面来表示可区分的空间对象。
essence.en: Vector data represents distinguishable spatial objects with coordinate-based points, lines, and polygons.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 管理道路、地块和设施时，你往往需要保留每个对象的独立边界和属性。
why_it_matters.en: For roads, parcels, and facilities, you often need each object’s own geometry and attributes.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 不给世界涂满格子，而是把一个个对象的轮廓描出来。
fresh_take.en: Instead of filling cells, vector data traces objects one by one.

translation_note.zh-Hans: Vector data 通常译“矢量数据”，不是物理学中的“矢量”概念。
translation_note.en: Vector data refers to a GIS representation model, not vectors in physics.

definition.en: Raster data represents a geographic area as a regular grid of cells, each holding one or more values for a measured or classified property.
definition.zh-Hans: 栅格数据以规则网格单元表示地理区域，每个单元存储某种测量值、分类值或多个波段的数值。

plain.zh-Hans: 把地图铺上一张方格纸，每格写下气温、高度，或影像中的颜色波段值。格子连在一起，就描述了整个区域的空间变化。
plain.en: Lay a grid over an area. Each cell stores a temperature, elevation, or image-band value; together the cells describe spatial variation.

example.en: A temperature surface stores estimated temperature values cell by cell across a region.
example.zh-Hans: 一张气温栅格图按网格单元记录区域内的气温估计值。

misconception.en: Raster cell size is a spatial sampling property, not proof of measurement accuracy or image quality.
misconception.zh-Hans: 像元大小表示空间采样粒度，不直接等于测量精度，也不代表影像一定更清晰。

essence.zh-Hans: 把空间组织为网格，并在每个格子中保存数值。
essence.en: Raster data organizes space into cells, each holding a value or values.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 气温、海拔、影像波段等覆盖区域的数值信息，常能自然地以栅格进行计算。
why_it_matters.en: Temperature, elevation, and image bands are often efficiently modeled and analyzed as raster values across an area.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 把地图铺成方格纸，让每个格子说出自己知道的数值。
fresh_take.en: Spread a grid over space and let every cell report a value.

translation_note.zh-Hans: Raster data 常译“栅格数据”；像元 pixel 是其中的单元概念，二者不是同义词。
translation_note.en: Raster is the data model; a pixel or cell is one of its units.

definition.en: A digital elevation model (DEM) is a digital representation of elevations across a terrain or surface, commonly structured as a grid; what the elevations represent must be established from the dataset specification.
definition.zh-Hans: 数字高程模型（DEM）是对地形或某种表面高程的数字化表达，常采用规则网格组织；具体代表裸地地面还是其他表面，需要根据数据产品说明确认。

plain.zh-Hans: 想象一张有高低分数的方格地图：有的格子海拔 80 米，有的 200 米。利用这些高程值可以计算坡度；但要先确认数字代表裸地还是其他表面。
plain.en: Imagine a gridded map where cells hold elevations such as 80 m or 200 m. You can derive slopes, but first check whether the heights represent bare ground or another surface.

example.en: A terrain analyst uses a bare-earth elevation raster to derive slope and identify steep hillsides.
example.zh-Hans: 地形分析人员使用表示裸地地面的高程栅格计算坡度，找出陡坡区域。

misconception.en: In USGS product usage DEM often means a bare-earth surface, but scientific terminology also uses DEM more broadly; do not assume every dataset excludes buildings and trees.
misconception.zh-Hans: USGS 的具体 DEM 产品通常表示去除建筑与植被后的裸地地面；但学术文献中 DEM 也常作更宽泛的总称，不能据名称就断定数据一定去除了地物。

essence.zh-Hans: 以数字方式记录地表或指定表面的高程。
essence.en: A DEM records elevation for terrain or a defined surface.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 从高程模型可以推导坡度、地形阴影与汇水方向，但前提是先弄清它表示哪种表面。
why_it_matters.en: A DEM supports slope, hillshade, and drainage analysis, provided you know which surface it represents.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 山还没被画成立体图，先化作了一张高低起伏的数字成绩单。
fresh_take.en: Before terrain becomes a 3D scene, its heights are written as numbers.

translation_note.zh-Hans: DEM 常泛指数字高程表面；在部分 USGS 产品语境中特指规则格网的裸地高程。不能无条件与 DSM 或 DTM 等同。
translation_note.en: DEM may be used broadly for elevation models; some USGS products use it specifically for gridded bare-earth elevation.

definition.en: A coordinate reference system (CRS) defines how coordinate values correspond to positions in a specified spatial reference framework, including the coordinate system and relevant reference information.
definition.zh-Hans: 坐标参考系统（CRS）规定坐标值如何对应到参考框架中的空间位置，包含坐标系统及相关参考基准等信息。

plain.zh-Hans: 同样是数字“116、40”，它们可能是经纬度，也可能根本不是位置。CRS 像坐标随附的说明书，告诉软件数字采用什么参考框架、单位和规则。
plain.en: The numbers “116, 40” alone do not identify a place. A CRS is the reference guide that tells software how to interpret coordinate values.

example.en: A latitude-longitude dataset in EPSG:4326 is reprojected for display with a meter-based projected CRS.
example.zh-Hans: 一份使用 EPSG:4326 经纬度坐标的数据，可以转换后用以米为单位的投影坐标参考系统显示。

misconception.en: Assigning a CRS label does not convert coordinate values. Defining a missing CRS and transforming into another CRS are different operations.
misconception.zh-Hans: 给数据指定一个 CRS 名称，并不会自动改变其坐标值。“定义原有 CRS”和“转换到新 CRS”是不同操作。

essence.zh-Hans: 说明一组坐标如何对应到真实空间位置的规则。
essence.en: A CRS specifies how coordinate values correspond to real spatial positions.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 不同数据要叠加、换算或测距，必须先知道它们的 CRS 是否兼容。
why_it_matters.en: To overlay datasets, transform coordinates, or measure distances, you must know their reference systems.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 坐标数字看似精确；少了参考系，它连“在哪儿”都说不清。
fresh_take.en: Coordinates can look precise, yet without a reference system they cannot tell you where.

translation_note.zh-Hans: 「坐标参考系统」和「坐标参考系」均常见；不要把 CRS 等同于单独的地图投影或大地基准。
translation_note.en: CRS includes the coordinate reference framework; it is not synonymous with a projection or datum alone.

definition.en: A geographic CRS identifies positions using angular coordinates on a geographic reference framework, commonly longitude and latitude, together with its geodetic reference information.
definition.zh-Hans: 地理坐标参考系统利用地理参考框架中的角度坐标定位，通常使用经度、纬度，并包含相应的大地测量参考信息。

plain.zh-Hans: 手机里看到的经纬度就是一种常见例子：它用角度说明位置。不过在不同纬度，经度变化 1° 代表的实际距离并不相同。
plain.en: Longitude and latitude are familiar angular coordinates. But one degree of longitude spans different physical distances at different latitudes.

example.en: A GPS track is exported as longitude and latitude in a WGS 84 geographic CRS.
example.zh-Hans: 一条 GPS 轨迹可以按 WGS 84 地理坐标参考系统输出经纬度。

misconception.en: One degree of longitude is not a fixed distance everywhere on Earth; do not treat degree values as meters.
misconception.zh-Hans: 一个经度差 1° 在不同纬度对应的实际距离不同，不能把角度坐标直接当作米来计算。

essence.zh-Hans: 以经纬度等角度坐标表达地理位置的坐标参考系统。
essence.en: A geographic CRS represents location with angular coordinates such as longitude and latitude.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 读懂经纬度与角度单位，才能正确判断数据是否适合直接进行距离和面积计算。
why_it_matters.en: Understanding longitude, latitude, and angular units prevents misleading distance and area calculations.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 经纬度擅长说位置，可别逼每一“度”都当成一米。
fresh_take.en: Longitude and latitude tell you where, but a degree is not a meter.

translation_note.zh-Hans: Esri 中文文档通常使用「地理坐标系」，此处保留「地理坐标参考系统」以对应 Geographic CRS。
translation_note.en: ArcGIS Chinese documentation commonly says 地理坐标系; this entry names the broader Geographic CRS concept.

definition.en: A projected CRS uses a map projection and a base geographic reference framework to assign planar coordinates, generally in linear units, to geographic positions.
definition.zh-Hans: 投影坐标参考系统以地理参考框架和地图投影为基础，将地理位置表示为平面坐标，通常采用米或英尺等长度单位。

plain.zh-Hans: 为了在工程图上方便量距离和面积，常把地球表面的位置投影到平面，再用 x、y 表示。像把曲面摊到纸上，便于操作，却不保证处处无变形。
plain.en: For practical local measurements, positions are projected onto a plane as x and y. Like flattening a curved surface onto paper, it is useful but involves distortion.

example.en: An engineering team uses a suitable local projected CRS to estimate lengths and areas around a construction site.
example.zh-Hans: 工程团队选择适合当地的投影坐标参考系统，测算建设区域内的长度与面积。

misconception.en: A projected CRS does not guarantee distortion-free distance or area. The projection and region of use matter.
misconception.zh-Hans: 使用投影坐标参考系统，并不意味着所有距离和面积都没有变形；结果取决于所选投影及使用区域。

essence.zh-Hans: 用地图投影将地理位置转换为平面坐标的参考系统。
essence.en: A projected CRS uses a map projection to express geographic positions as planar coordinates.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 合适的投影坐标参考系统能方便局部测绘和测量，但要留意使用范围与变形。
why_it_matters.en: A suitable projected CRS supports local mapping and measurements, within its intended area and distortion limits.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 把地球的曲面折算成一张平面账本；算得方便，也要知道哪里打了折。
fresh_take.en: It puts the curved Earth on a flat ledger—convenient, but not distortion-free.

translation_note.zh-Hans: Esri 常用「投影坐标系」。它由地理坐标系与投影等要素构成，而不只是投影公式。
translation_note.en: A projected CRS includes the underlying geographic CRS plus conversion and planar axes; it is more than a map projection formula.

definition.en: A map projection is a mathematical mapping from locations on a curved reference surface to positions on a plane, necessarily introducing trade-offs in shape, area, distance, or direction.
definition.zh-Hans: 地图投影是将曲面参考地球上的位置通过数学方法映射到平面上的过程或方法，不可避免地需要在形状、面积、距离或方向等性质之间作出取舍。

plain.zh-Hans: 试着把橘子皮完整铺平，就会发现拉伸或撕裂难以避免。地图投影也需要取舍：有的尽量保面积，有的尽量保局部形状。
plain.en: Try flattening an orange peel without stretching or tearing it. Map projections face similar trade-offs: some preserve area, others local shape.

example.en: A thematic world map may use an equal-area projection to compare country sizes without area exaggeration.
example.zh-Hans: 为了比较不同国家的面积，专题世界地图可采用等积投影，避免系统性夸大某些地区的面积。

misconception.en: No flat map projection preserves all properties everywhere; a visually familiar projection is not necessarily appropriate for measurement.
misconception.zh-Hans: 不存在能在全球各处同时保持所有几何性质的平面投影；看起来熟悉的投影不一定适合做面积或距离测量。

essence.zh-Hans: 用数学规则把地球曲面上的位置映射到平面上。
essence.en: A map projection maps positions from a curved Earth model onto a plane.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 选错投影会改变地图上面积、形状或距离的直观印象，甚至影响分析结论。
why_it_matters.en: A poor projection choice can mislead visual comparisons of size, shape, or distance—and affect analysis.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 地球想铺平，形状、面积、距离，总得有人让一步。
fresh_take.en: Flatten the Earth, and shape, area, or distance must give something up.

translation_note.zh-Hans: 「地图投影」是坐标转换所用的数学方法，不应与采用它的整个投影坐标参考系统混称。
translation_note.en: Map projection names a mathematical conversion, not the entire projected coordinate reference system.

definition.en: World Geodetic System 1984 (WGS 84) is a global geodetic reference system used for positioning; geographic CRSs such as WGS 84 latitude-longitude depend on this reference framework.
definition.zh-Hans: 世界大地测量系统 1984（WGS 84）是一种用于全球定位的大地测量参考系统；例如 WGS 84 经纬度坐标参考系统便依赖这一参考框架。

plain.en: When a device reports a latitude and longitude, WGS 84 is a common reference for interpreting where that position is on Earth.
plain.zh-Hans: 设备给出一组经纬度时，WGS 84 是常见的全球参考框架，帮助解释这些数字所对应的位置。

example.en: A GNSS receiver exports a waypoint in a WGS 84-related geographic coordinate reference system.
example.zh-Hans: 一台 GNSS 接收机以 WGS 84 相关的地理坐标参考系统导出定位点。

misconception.en: WGS 84 is not the same thing as Web Mercator (EPSG:3857), and the name WGS 84 alone does not specify a map projection or coordinate order.
misconception.zh-Hans: WGS 84 不等于 Web Mercator（EPSG:3857）；单说 WGS 84 也不能完整确定地图投影或坐标轴顺序。

essence.zh-Hans: 全球定位中常用的地球参考框架及相关大地测量系统。
essence.en: WGS 84 provides a widely used global geodetic reference framework for positioning.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 交换 GNSS 定位数据时，知道其参考框架有助于避免位置被错误解释。
why_it_matters.en: Knowing the reference frame helps prevent misinterpreting shared GNSS positions.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 地球上人人都能报坐标，前提是先说好参照哪套地球。
fresh_take.en: Everyone can report coordinates—once they agree which Earth reference to use.

translation_note.zh-Hans: WGS 84 可指大地参考框架及其相关坐标参考系统。EPSG:4326 是一个使用 WGS 84 的地理 CRS，二者不可直接当作同义词。
translation_note.en: WGS 84 denotes a geodetic reference family; EPSG:4326 is a particular WGS 84 geographic CRS, not the entire WGS 84 system.

definition.en: Georeferencing is the process of establishing the spatial position of an image, map, or other dataset by relating locations within it to known geographic coordinates or spatial references.
definition.zh-Hans: 地理配准是通过建立图像、地图或其他数据内部位置与已知地理坐标之间的对应关系，确定其空间位置的过程。

plain.zh-Hans: 一张扫描的老地图有街道，却不知道如何放到现在的地图上。找到图上路口与真实位置的对应点，再计算变换，就能把它配准到地理空间。
plain.en: An old scanned map shows streets but has no usable geographic placement. Match recognizable points to known locations and transform the image into place.

example.en: An old city plan is aligned to current GIS data by adding control-point pairs and applying a transformation.
example.zh-Hans: 将老城市规划图中的几个控制点与现有 GIS 地图上的对应点匹配，再通过变换将旧图配准。

misconception.en: Georeferencing is not the same as geocoding: the former positions spatial content, while the latter resolves text such as an address into a location.
misconception.zh-Hans: 地理配准不等于地理编码。前者使图像或数据具有正确的地理定位，后者通常把地址或地名文字解析成位置。

essence.zh-Hans: 将一张图或一份数据的内部位置与已知地理坐标建立对应。
essence.en: Georeferencing ties locations within an image or dataset to known geographic coordinates.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 老地图、航拍图或扫描图如果缺少可靠的位置关联，就难以叠加到现代 GIS 数据上。
why_it_matters.en: Without reliable geographic placement, old maps and scanned plans cannot be meaningfully overlaid with current GIS layers.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 给一张漂在屏幕上的旧地图，找回它在地球上的位置。
fresh_take.en: Give a floating old map its place back on Earth.

translation_note.zh-Hans: Esri 中文文档使用「地理配准」。与将地址解析为位置的 Geocoding（地理编码）不同。
translation_note.en: Esri uses 地理配准 for georeferencing; it is not address geocoding.

definition.en: Geocoding converts a textual description of a place, such as an address or place name, into a geographic location, often returning candidate matches and a match score.
definition.zh-Hans: 地理编码将地址、地名等文本位置描述转换为地理位置，通常还会返回候选匹配结果及匹配评分。

plain.zh-Hans: 输入“某某路 10 号”，服务尝试找到它在地图上的位置。这个从文字到位置的过程叫地理编码；匹配结果还需要看质量和精度。
plain.en: Type an address and a service tries to locate it on a map. That text-to-location process is geocoding, and the match still needs quality checks.

example.en: A delivery company converts customer addresses into coordinates to plan distribution routes.
example.zh-Hans: 配送公司将客户地址转换为坐标，以便规划配送路线。

misconception.en: Geocoding results are estimates or matches, not guaranteed survey-grade positions; reverse geocoding is the opposite direction.
misconception.zh-Hans: 地理编码结果通常是匹配或推断的位置，不保证达到测绘级精度；由坐标查地址则叫逆地理编码。

essence.zh-Hans: 把人能读懂的地址或地名转换为地图可用的位置。
essence.en: Geocoding converts human-readable place descriptions into mappable locations.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 把客户地址、事故记录或服务请求转成坐标后，才能做地图分布与空间分析。
why_it_matters.en: Once addresses or incident reports become locations, they can be mapped and analyzed spatially.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 把人类写的地址，翻译成地图能理解的位置。
fresh_take.en: Translate an address written for people into a place a map can use.

translation_note.zh-Hans: 这里的「地理编码」指由地址或地点描述获取位置，不是地理配准，也不等同于任意数据的编码。
translation_note.en: Geocoding here resolves address or place descriptions to locations; it is not georeferencing.

definition.en: A buffer is a spatial region defined by a distance criterion around one or more input geometries; buffer operations commonly construct polygons representing that region.
definition.zh-Hans: 缓冲区是根据给定距离条件围绕一个或多个输入几何构建的空间区域；缓冲区操作通常将其表示为面。

plain.zh-Hans: 你想找学校周围 500 米以内的设施：先以学校位置或范围为依据，构建符合距离条件的区域，再查询落在这个区域内的设施。这个区域就是缓冲区。
plain.en: To find facilities within 500 m of a school, build an area based on the school’s geometry and a distance condition, then examine facilities in that area: that area is a buffer.

example.en: A planner creates 300-meter road buffers to identify buildings that may be affected by nearby traffic.
example.zh-Hans: 规划人员为道路建立 300 米缓冲区，用来筛选可能受到交通影响的建筑。

misconception.en: Buffer distances depend on the spatial reference and method: a planar buffer and a geodesic buffer need not produce identical results.
misconception.zh-Hans: 缓冲距离的含义取决于坐标参考系统与算法。平面缓冲区和测地线缓冲区的结果可能不同。

essence.zh-Hans: 根据距离阈值在空间对象周围构建区域。
essence.en: A buffer constructs an area around spatial objects using a distance threshold.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 想筛选学校周边的商店、道路附近的建筑或河流沿岸的设施，缓冲区能先定义“附近”的空间范围。
why_it_matters.en: Buffers turn “nearby” into an explicit area for screening stores near schools, buildings near roads, or facilities along rivers.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 不是让学校变大，而是让“离学校有多远”这件事有了形状。
fresh_take.en: The school has not grown; the idea of “within this distance” has taken shape.

translation_note.zh-Hans: Buffer 可指生成的区域或缓冲操作；应结合具体上下文，不把缓冲距离直接等同于实际道路距离。
translation_note.en: Buffer may refer to the resulting region or to a buffering operation; its distance measure is algorithm-dependent.

definition.en: Clip is a spatial operation that extracts the parts of an input dataset lying within or overlapping a specified boundary; in vector overlay workflows it retains intersecting geometry portions.
definition.zh-Hans: 裁剪是一种空间处理操作，用指定边界提取输入数据中位于或落入该范围的部分；在矢量叠加分析中，通常保留与裁剪范围相交的几何部分。

plain.zh-Hans: 你有全国河流数据，只研究一个省。裁剪会按省界保留省内对应的河流部分；这不只是把省外的内容临时藏起来。
plain.en: If you have rivers nationwide but study one province, clipping creates data for the portions inside the boundary; it is more than hiding what is outside.

example.en: A researcher clips a nationwide river dataset to the boundary of one province before analysis.
example.zh-Hans: 研究人员用某省边界裁剪全国河流数据，只保留省域内的部分。

misconception.en: Clip may modify feature geometries and is different from merely hiding data outside a view; raster clipping follows a different processing model.
misconception.zh-Hans: 裁剪可能真正改变输出要素的几何形状，不只是视觉上隐藏外部数据；栅格裁剪的具体处理方式又有所不同。

scope_note.en: This entry primarily describes vector-overlay clipping.
scope_note.zh-Hans: 本条目主要解释矢量叠加分析中的裁剪。

essence.zh-Hans: 按指定边界保留数据的空间部分。
essence.en: Clip extracts the portions of data lying within a chosen boundary.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 研究对象跨越多个行政区时，先裁剪到研究区能减少无关数据并明确分析范围。
why_it_matters.en: Clipping to a study area removes irrelevant portions and keeps analysis focused.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 世界没变小，只是这份研究决定先看边界里面。
fresh_take.en: The world has not shrunk; the analysis is looking only inside the boundary.

translation_note.zh-Hans: GIS 中的 Clip 是空间几何裁剪，不同于影像色彩或画面裁剪。
translation_note.en: GIS clip is a geometric overlay operation, not merely clipping an image's appearance.

definition.en: A spatial join associates attribute information between geographic features according to a spatial relationship, such as intersection, containment, or nearest proximity.
definition.zh-Hans: 空间连接依据相交、包含、最近邻等空间关系，在地理要素之间匹配并关联属性信息。

plain.zh-Hans: 商店数据有坐标，行政区数据有边界，但没有共同编号。空间连接可以根据“商店落在哪个区内”找到对应关系，把区名补到商店数据上。
plain.en: Stores have point locations and districts have boundaries, but no shared ID. A spatial join finds which district contains each store and can attach its name.

example.en: A health team counts clinics located inside each neighborhood and saves the counts as neighborhood attributes.
example.zh-Hans: 公共卫生团队统计每个街区中的诊所数量，并将统计结果写入街区属性。

misconception.en: Spatial join does not always produce one-to-one matches. Cardinality and chosen spatial predicates determine output records and summaries.
misconception.zh-Hans: 空间连接不一定是一对一关系；结果行数和统计方式取决于空间匹配条件及一对多等连接设置。

essence.zh-Hans: 按空间关系把两组要素的属性关联起来。
essence.en: A spatial join links attributes between features using spatial relationships.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 当两张表没有共同编号，却可以按位置对应时，就能给商店补上街区名称或统计区域内的设施。
why_it_matters.en: When tables lack a common ID but have spatial relationships, a spatial join can assign districts to stores or count facilities by area.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 两张表素不相识，地图替它们按位置牵了线。
fresh_take.en: Two tables have never met; location introduces them.

translation_note.zh-Hans: 官方 ArcGIS 中文名称为「空间连接」。它基于空间关系匹配属性，不等于 SQL 中仅靠字段键的普通 Join。
translation_note.en: ArcGIS calls this 空间连接; it matches features using spatial predicates rather than only attribute keys.

definition.en: Topology describes spatial relationships such as connectivity, adjacency, and containment; GIS topology models or rules can be used to maintain consistency among related geometries.
definition.zh-Hans: 拓扑描述空间对象之间的连通、邻接、包含等关系；GIS 中的拓扑模型或规则可以帮助维持相关几何之间的一致性。

plain.zh-Hans: 两条道路在屏幕上看着相交，不一定真的形成可通行的连接；相邻地块也可能不小心留下缝隙。拓扑关注并检查这些空间关系。
plain.en: Two roads may look as if they meet without being connected; parcels may accidentally leave gaps. Topology deals with such spatial relationships.

example.en: A road network checks that streets expected to connect really share junctions.
example.zh-Hans: 道路网络利用连通关系检查本应相接的道路是否真的在路口连接。

misconception.en: Topology is about relationships and constraints, not the same thing as geometry coordinates or an automatic guarantee of accurate data.
misconception.zh-Hans: 拓扑强调对象间的关系和约束，不等于几何坐标本身，也不代表一套数据自动就准确无误。

essence.zh-Hans: 关注地理对象之间如何连接、相邻、包含或重叠。
essence.en: Topology focuses on how spatial objects connect, touch, contain, or overlap.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 道路看起来接上了不一定真连通；相邻地块也可能有缝隙。拓扑检查能发现这类问题。
why_it_matters.en: Roads that look connected may not be; adjacent parcels may have gaps. Topology rules help detect such issues.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 地图里最重要的关系之一：挨着，不一定等于连着。
fresh_take.en: On a map, being close is not the same as being connected.

translation_note.zh-Hans: Topology 关注连接、邻接及共享边界规则，不能简单等同于图形外观。
translation_note.en: Topology governs connectivity and adjacency, not visual appearance alone.

definition.en: Web Map Service (WMS) is an OGC interface standard through which clients request rendered map representations for specified layers, geographic bounds, coordinate reference systems, and output formats.
definition.zh-Hans: 网络地图服务（WMS）是 OGC 制定的接口标准，允许客户端按图层、地理范围、坐标参考系统和输出格式等参数请求服务器生成地图图像。

plain.zh-Hans: 想在自己的网页地图上显示另一个机构发布的土地利用图？通过 WMS，你可以按范围和图层请求服务器绘制地图图像，而不必先下载全部原始要素。
plain.en: Want another agency’s land-use map in your app? WMS lets you request a rendered image for a chosen extent and layers without downloading the source features.

example.en: A public map portal overlays a government WMS with other web-map layers.
example.zh-Hans: 公共地图门户把政府发布的 WMS 地图叠加到已有的网页地图上。

misconception.en: WMS primarily serves map portrayals, not raw editable feature datasets. Optional GetFeatureInfo can return information about a map location.
misconception.zh-Hans: WMS 主要提供地图图像，而不是可直接编辑的原始要素数据。其可选的 GetFeatureInfo 操作可以查询地图指定位置的部分信息。

essence.zh-Hans: 让客户端向服务器请求已经绘制好的地图图像的 OGC 服务标准。
essence.en: WMS is an OGC service standard for requesting rendered map images from a server.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 你可以将外部机构的专题地图显示在自己的应用里，而不必先获取其全部原始地理数据。
why_it_matters.en: You can display another organization’s thematic map without downloading all its underlying geographic features.

fresh_take.zh-Hans: 不用搬走数据仓库，也可以请远方服务器给你画一张地图。
fresh_take.en: No need to move the data warehouse when the server can draw the map for you.

translation_note.zh-Hans: WMS 主要提供地图图像；需要读取要素几何属性时，应考虑 WFS 或 OGC API — Features。
translation_note.en: WMS serves map portrayal; feature data access is addressed by WFS or OGC API — Features.

definition.en: Data whose coordinates or geometry describe locations and spatial relationships.
definition.zh-Hans: 用坐标或几何表示位置及空间关系的数据。

plain.en: A street record becomes spatial data when located on a map.
plain.zh-Hans: 一条道路记录有了地图位置，就能分析它与周围地物的关系。

example.en: Combine roads and flood zones to identify exposed roads.
example.zh-Hans: 叠加道路和洪水区，识别受影响路段。

misconception.en: A place name alone may not supply an unambiguous geometry.
misconception.zh-Hans: 仅有地点名称未必能直接用于空间几何分析。

essence.zh-Hans: 用位置把不同来源的信息连接到同一张地理空间里。
essence.en: Spatial data links information from different sources through location.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 城市管理、应急响应或选址时，只有数据能正确定位，才有条件比较它们的空间关系。
why_it_matters.en: Planning and emergency decisions depend on locating datasets consistently enough to compare their relationships.

fresh_take.en: Give information a place and places a question.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 给信息安上位置，也给位置加上问题。

translation_note.en: Spatial and geospatial data often overlap in usage, but their scope depends on discipline.
translation_note.zh-Hans: Spatial Data 与 Geospatial Data 在入门语境常交替使用；专业领域仍应注意定义范围。

definition.en: A selective visual representation of geographic information at a chosen scale and extent.
definition.zh-Hans: 按一定比例尺和范围，有选择地表达地理信息的图形。

plain.en: A map emphasizes some features while simplifying others.
plain.zh-Hans: 地图不是世界的复印件，而是针对问题进行的取舍。

example.en: A transit map emphasizes connectivity over precise shapes.
example.zh-Hans: 地铁线路图强调换乘关系而非道路真实形状。

misconception.en: Every map selects and generalizes information.
misconception.zh-Hans: 地图会选择与概括，不可能保留所有细节。

essence.zh-Hans: 地图是为某个问题有选择地组织、表达地理信息。
essence.en: A map selects and organizes geographic information for a particular purpose.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 同一批数据可以用交通图、风险图或地形图表达；先明确要回答什么，才能选择合适的地图。
why_it_matters.en: The same data can support a transit map, risk map, or terrain map; deciding the question guides what the map should show.

fresh_take.en: The world is complex; maps choose what matters.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 世界太复杂，地图负责有重点地说。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Map 是一般意义上的地图，不等同于 Web Map（网络地图或共享配置），也不是 Basemap（底图）。
translation_note.en: Map is the general representation; Web Map and Basemap have more specific roles.

definition.en: The ratio of a map distance to its corresponding ground distance under specified conditions.
definition.zh-Hans: 地图距离与相应实地距离之比，适用于其规定的条件。

plain.en: At 1:10,000, one centimeter represents about 100 meters.
plain.zh-Hans: 比例尺为 1:10000 时，图上 1 厘米大致代表实地 100 米。

example.en: Choose a scale appropriate for viewing building outlines.
example.zh-Hans: 根据需要选择显示建筑轮廓的比例尺。

misconception.en: Interactive-map scale changes with zoom and display settings.
misconception.zh-Hans: 交互地图的显示比例尺受缩放和设备影响。

essence.zh-Hans: 比例尺连接图上距离与实地距离，也影响能呈现多少细节。
essence.en: Map scale relates display distance to ground distance and influences visible detail.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 选错比例尺，建筑轮廓可能糊成一团，或把局部精度误用到大范围分析。
why_it_matters.en: A poor scale choice can hide essential details or tempt readers to use a local view for unsuitable broad-area measurements.

fresh_take.en: A gatekeeper for map detail.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 不是把世界缩小，是给细节设一道门槛。

translation_note.en: Map scale describes a distance ratio; a scale bar is its graphical representation.
translation_note.zh-Hans: Map Scale 指图上距离与实地距离的关系；Scale Bar 是表现这种关系的图形元素。

definition.en: The geographic area covered by a map view, often represented by a bounding rectangle.
definition.zh-Hans: 地图视图覆盖的区域，通常可用外包矩形描述。

plain.en: Panning and zooming change your current extent.
plain.zh-Hans: 拖动缩放地图，就在改变正在看的地理区域。

example.en: Zoom to the extent of selected parcels.
example.zh-Hans: 缩放地图以显示所选地块。

misconception.en: An extent is not a dataset's exact boundary.
misconception.zh-Hans: 范围框不等于数据的真实边界。

essence.zh-Hans: 地图范围是当前视图的空间窗口，而不是数据本身的边界。
essence.en: Map extent is the spatial window of a view, not necessarily the boundary of its data.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 理解范围有助于控制地图初始视角、批量查询区域，并避免把屏幕外的空白当作缺失数据。
why_it_matters.en: Extent controls initial views and area-based queries and prevents confusion between off-screen data and absent data.

fresh_take.en: A window onto the world, not its border.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 把世界打开一扇窗，窗外仍有世界。

translation_note.en: A map view's extent should not be confused with a dataset's actual footprint.
translation_note.zh-Hans: Map Extent 是地图的当前范围，可能不同于数据的实际覆盖边界。

definition.en: Ordered numerical values specifying a position within a coordinate system.
definition.zh-Hans: 在给定坐标系中确定位置的一组有顺序的数值。

plain.en: Numbers only locate a place when the reference system is known.
plain.zh-Hans: 只有知道参考系统，坐标数字才能说明位置。

example.en: Locate a station from longitude and latitude.
example.zh-Hans: 通过经纬度定位监测站。

misconception.en: Reversed axis order can place a point incorrectly.
misconception.zh-Hans: 弄反经纬度顺序可能使位置严重偏移。

essence.zh-Hans: 坐标要连同坐标系一起，才能可靠地表达位置。
essence.en: Coordinates locate a position reliably only when paired with their coordinate system.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 交换定位数据时，缺少坐标系或弄错轴顺序，会让原本正确的数字指向错误地点。
why_it_matters.en: When sharing locations, an unknown CRS or wrong axis order can turn correct numbers into incorrect places.

fresh_take.en: Numbers need a frame of reference.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 坐标不是地址，先要说明参照系。

translation_note.en: A coordinate tuple needs a reference system and axis-order convention.
translation_note.zh-Hans: 坐标值必须与其参考系统和坐标轴顺序一起解释。

definition.en: A zero-dimensional geometry representing a position without length or area.
definition.zh-Hans: 用于表示位置、没有长度和面积的零维几何。

plain.en: A sensor may be represented by one point.
plain.zh-Hans: 一座监测站可以简化为地图上的一个点。

example.en: Map bus stops as point features.
example.zh-Hans: 用点要素展示公交车站。

misconception.en: The marker's screen size is not real-world area.
misconception.zh-Hans: 屏幕上的点符号大小不是实际面积。

essence.zh-Hans: 点几何用一个位置来抽象无需表达面积或长度的对象。
essence.en: Point geometry represents a location without modeling an object's area or length.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 站点、传感器和采样位置适合用点处理，能方便计算分布、最近设施及覆盖情况。
why_it_matters.en: Sensors, stops, and sampling sites become easy to map, count, and compare with nearby facilities when modeled as points.

fresh_take.en: Keep the where; leave out the shape.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 一个点，省略形状，留下位置。

translation_note.en: Point geometry is not the same as a point feature, which also carries identity and attributes.
translation_note.zh-Hans: 这里是 Point Geometry（点几何），不是 Point Feature（点要素）；后者还包括属性和身份。

definition.en: An ordered series of vertices forming a path or paths.
definition.zh-Hans: 由一串有序顶点构成的线性路径几何。

plain.en: Roads and rivers can be represented as joined segments.
plain.zh-Hans: 道路和河流可以用连接起来的线段表达。

example.en: Measure a hiking trail's length.
example.zh-Hans: 测量徒步路线的长度。

misconception.en: Touching lines are not necessarily traversable network edges.
misconception.zh-Hans: 线在地图上相接不一定能在现实中通行。

essence.zh-Hans: 线几何用有顺序的顶点描述路径和线状地物。
essence.en: Line geometry uses ordered vertices to describe paths and linear features.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 道路、河流和管线的长度与走向依赖线形数据；但是否可通行还需要网络规则。
why_it_matters.en: Road, river, and pipe geometry supports lengths and direction; actual traversability still requires network rules.

fresh_take.en: An ordered trail of positions.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 把曲折的路，写成一串有序的点。

translation_note.en: Line geometry is broad, while polyline is a common implementation; touching drawings do not guarantee network connectivity.
translation_note.zh-Hans: Line Geometry 是总称，Polyline 是常见实现；不能仅因屏幕上的线相交就推断网络可通。

definition.en: A geometry defining an enclosed area using boundary rings.
definition.zh-Hans: 利用边界环定义封闭区域的几何。

plain.en: The outline of a park becomes a polygon.
plain.zh-Hans: 公园轮廓可表示成一个面。

example.en: Find houses within a flood-risk area.
example.zh-Hans: 查找位于洪水风险区内的住宅。

misconception.en: Polygons can contain holes and must obey geometry rules.
misconception.zh-Hans: 面可能有内洞，其边界还需满足几何规则。

essence.zh-Hans: 面几何把连续区域的边界与内部清楚地表达出来。
essence.en: Polygon geometry represents the boundary and interior of an area.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 土地用途、行政区或洪水范围的叠加统计都需要可靠的面边界，否则包含关系和面积会出错。
why_it_matters.en: Land-use, district, and flood-area analysis needs valid boundaries for meaningful areas and containment tests.

fresh_take.en: A boundary gives inside its meaning.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 有边界，才有“在里面”。

translation_note.en: Polygon geometry may have interior rings, and multipart area representations require careful distinction.
translation_note.zh-Hans: Polygon 通常是面几何的基本形式，GIS 面还可能有洞或多个组成部分。

definition.en: A table of properties associated with geographic features.
definition.zh-Hans: 与地理要素关联的属性数据表。

plain.en: A road's shape shows where; the table stores its name.
plain.zh-Hans: 道路形状说明在哪儿，表格说明道路叫什么。

example.en: Filter parcels by land-use type.
example.zh-Hans: 按用地类型筛选宗地。

misconception.en: Rows must be properly associated with features.
misconception.zh-Hans: 不能随意按照行号把属性和几何拼接。

essence.zh-Hans: 属性表保存要素的描述信息，让地图上的形状可以被查询和比较。
essence.en: Attribute tables store descriptive facts that make mapped features searchable and comparable.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 图上看起来相似的地块，可能在用途、人口或时间上完全不同；属性表让这些差异可分析。
why_it_matters.en: Parcels that look alike may differ in use, population, or survey date; attributes make those distinctions analyzable.

fresh_take.en: The details behind the shapes.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 地图的形状有故事，属性表负责记细节。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Attribute Table 记录要素属性，不等于地理要素本身的几何或 Feature Class。
translation_note.en: Attribute tables hold properties and should not be confused with feature geometry or a feature class.

definition.en: A named column defining a kind of value for records.
definition.zh-Hans: 表中为记录保存某种数据值的命名列。

plain.en: One field holds population; another holds year.
plain.zh-Hans: 一列保存人口，另一列保存年份。

example.en: Add a numeric building-height field.
example.zh-Hans: 增加一个数值类型的建筑高度字段。

misconception.en: A text field cannot automatically be used for numeric arithmetic.
misconception.zh-Hans: 文本字段不能直接作为数字参与计算。

essence.zh-Hans: 字段规定每条记录某项信息的名称与数据类型。
essence.en: A field defines the name and kind of a value in every record.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 人口应存为可计算的数值，日期应能按时间比较；合理的字段设计决定后续分析是否顺利。
why_it_matters.en: Population should be numeric and dates comparable; sound field definitions make reliable filtering and calculation possible.

fresh_take.en: A named slot for one kind of value.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 给每条记录留一个固定的小格子。

translation_note.en: A field is a column definition; an attribute is a property or value associated with a feature.
translation_note.zh-Hans: Field 是列的定义，而 Attribute 是要素的一项属性值或性质。

definition.en: A collection of geographic features sharing geometry type, fields and spatial reference in a GIS data model.
definition.zh-Hans: 在特定 GIS 数据模型中，共享几何类型、字段结构和空间参考的要素集合。

plain.en: A road feature class holds road lines with a shared schema.
plain.zh-Hans: 道路要素类保存字段结构一致的道路几何。

example.en: Store property boundaries in one polygon feature class.
example.zh-Hans: 用一个面要素类存储宗地边界。

misconception.en: Not all formats use the feature-class concept.
misconception.zh-Hans: 并非所有 GIS 格式都称这种集合为要素类。

essence.zh-Hans: 要素类把结构一致的地理要素作为一个数据集管理。
essence.en: A feature class manages geographic features that share a common schema and geometry model.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 在 ArcGIS 中组织道路或地块时，要素类让字段、几何类型与空间参考保持一致，也便于执行地理处理。
why_it_matters.en: In ArcGIS, feature classes keep roads or parcels under consistent schemas and spatial references for dependable processing.

fresh_take.en: A structured home for similar features.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 给相似的地物，建一份有规矩的名单。

translation_note.en: Feature class is a standard ArcGIS data-model term and should not be applied indiscriminately to every feature collection.
translation_note.zh-Hans: ArcGIS 官方中文术语为「要素类」。不宜把所有 GeoJSON 集合都称为 ArcGIS 要素类。

definition.en: A storage and management model for geographic datasets and rules.
definition.zh-Hans: 用于存储与管理地理数据集及相关规则的数据模型。

plain.en: Features, tables, relations and rules can be managed together.
plain.zh-Hans: 要素、表、关系和规则可以统一管理。

example.en: Manage parcel and land-use data together.
example.zh-Hans: 统一管理宗地和土地利用数据。

misconception.en: Not every GIS file is a geodatabase.
misconception.zh-Hans: 并不是所有 GIS 文件都是地理数据库。

essence.zh-Hans: 地理数据库不仅储存数据，也能组织关联和空间规则。
essence.en: A geodatabase organizes geographic data along with relationships and rules.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 多个要素类需要协同编辑时，统一的数据结构和约束可以减少孤立数据和不一致。
why_it_matters.en: When multiple feature classes are edited together, shared structure and constraints reduce disconnected or inconsistent records.

fresh_take.en: Storage with spatial rules.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 地图数据不仅要住得下，还得住得有秩序。

translation_note.en: Geodatabase can refer to file, mobile, or enterprise implementations and is not synonymous with all spatial databases.
translation_note.zh-Hans: Geodatabase 包含不同的具体存储类型（文件、移动、企业等），不等同于任何空间数据库。

definition.en: A JSON-based standard format for geographic geometries and features.
definition.zh-Hans: 用 JSON 编码地理几何和要素的标准格式。

plain.en: GeoJSON can describe points together with their properties.
plain.zh-Hans: GeoJSON 能表达点要素以及它们的属性。

example.en: Exchange locations between a web app and GIS tools.
example.zh-Hans: 在 Web 应用和 GIS 软件间交换点位。

misconception.en: Standard GeoJSON uses WGS 84 with longitude before latitude.
misconception.zh-Hans: 标准 GeoJSON 采用 WGS 84，经度在前、纬度在后。

essence.zh-Hans: GeoJSON 让地理要素成为易于通过 Web 交换的结构化 JSON。
essence.en: GeoJSON encodes geographic features as web-friendly structured JSON.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 开发地图应用或共享小型数据集时，它便于浏览器直接读取；必须注意 RFC 7946 的经纬度顺序。
why_it_matters.en: It is convenient for browser apps and small exchanges, but RFC 7946's longitude-first coordinate order must be respected.

fresh_take.en: Geography in a web-friendly syntax.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 让地理要素说一门程序员熟悉的语言。

translation_note.en: RFC 7946 coordinates use longitude then latitude (OGC CRS84 ordering); do not confuse this with the formal EPSG:4326 axis order.
translation_note.zh-Hans: RFC 7946 规定标准 GeoJSON 为 WGS 84 经度在前、纬度在后，其形式对应 OGC CRS84；不能直接按 EPSG:4326 的正式轴顺序交换字段。

definition.en: A legacy vector format stored in several interdependent files.
definition.zh-Hans: 由多个相互依赖文件构成的传统矢量格式。

plain.en: A .shp needs companion files such as .dbf and .shx.
plain.zh-Hans: Shapefile 并不只有 .shp，还通常需要 .dbf、.shx 等文件。

example.en: Exchange road data with an older GIS tool.
example.zh-Hans: 和旧版 GIS 软件交换道路数据。

misconception.en: Field names, types, and text encoding have limitations.
misconception.zh-Hans: 字段名、类型与字符编码存在限制。

essence.zh-Hans: Shapefile 是由一组配套文件共同构成的传统矢量数据集。
essence.en: A Shapefile is a legacy vector dataset made of several companion files.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 传输时漏掉 .dbf 或 .shx 就可能丢属性或无法读取；新项目还需留意编码和字段限制。
why_it_matters.en: Leaving out .dbf or .shx can break exchange; newer projects must also consider encoding and field limitations.

fresh_take.en: One dataset, several traveling companions.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 看似一个文件，出门常得带上全家。

translation_note.en: A Shapefile is a multi-file dataset, not a lone .shp or a generic shape file.
translation_note.zh-Hans: 这里的 Shapefile 是一个多文件数据集，而非单独的 .shp 文件。中文常用「形状文件」，但不宜理解为任意形状文件。

definition.en: An open SQLite-based geospatial container for features, tiles and more.
definition.zh-Hans: 基于 SQLite 的开放式地理空间容器格式，可容纳要素和瓦片等。

plain.en: A single .gpkg may contain multiple layers.
plain.zh-Hans: 一个 .gpkg 文件就可能包含多个图层。

example.en: Share an offline survey dataset.
example.zh-Hans: 交换外业调查所需的离线数据。

misconception.en: Implementations need not support every extension.
misconception.zh-Hans: 软件不一定支持 GeoPackage 的所有扩展功能。

essence.zh-Hans: GeoPackage 把多类地理数据放进可携带的 SQLite 容器。
essence.en: GeoPackage packages geospatial content in a portable SQLite container.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 离线采集或跨软件交付时，一个文件可以管理多个图层，但仍要核对接收方对扩展的支持。
why_it_matters.en: For offline collection or cross-tool delivery, one file can hold several layers, though extension support still needs checking.

fresh_take.en: A portable box for geodata.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 把多层地图装进一个便携箱子。

translation_note.en: GeoPackage is an OGC SQLite container standard, distinct from Esri's geodatabase model.
translation_note.zh-Hans: GeoPackage 是 OGC 的 SQLite 容器标准，不等于 Esri 的 Geodatabase。

definition.en: A TIFF-based raster format with geographic referencing information.
definition.zh-Hans: 包含地理参考信息的 TIFF 栅格格式。

plain.en: It stores pixels and information locating them on Earth.
plain.zh-Hans: 它保存像素值，也保存像素在地球上的位置。

example.en: Deliver an orthorectified aerial image.
example.zh-Hans: 交付一幅具有空间参考的航空影像。

misconception.en: GeoTIFF can store numeric rasters, not just photographs.
misconception.zh-Hans: GeoTIFF 不一定是照片，也可能保存高程数值。

essence.zh-Hans: GeoTIFF 在栅格像素之外保存它们所需的地理定位信息。
essence.en: GeoTIFF stores the geographic information needed to locate raster pixels.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 高程或遥感影像要和其他地图数据叠加，像元值之外还必须知道其位置和空间参考。
why_it_matters.en: Elevation and imagery rasters can only align with other maps when their positions and spatial reference are known.

fresh_take.en: Pixels with a place on Earth.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 给每个像素安排一个地理座位。

translation_note.en: GeoTIFF is georeferenced TIFF; COG imposes additional layout requirements for efficient remote access.
translation_note.zh-Hans: GeoTIFF 表示带地理参考的 TIFF 栅格；云优化 GeoTIFF（COG）是其特定组织形式，不应混为一谈。

definition.en: One cell of a raster grid holding data or a missing-data marker.
definition.zh-Hans: 栅格网格中的基本单元，保存值或缺失标记。

plain.en: Every cell has its position and value.
plain.zh-Hans: 每个像元都有位置，也有对应数据值。

example.en: Read elevation from a DEM cell.
example.zh-Hans: 读取 DEM 像元的高程值。

misconception.en: Cell size does not establish source accuracy.
misconception.zh-Hans: 像元小不意味着数据一定更精确。

essence.zh-Hans: 栅格像元是空间网格中承载一个或多个数值的基本单元。
essence.en: A raster cell is the basic grid unit holding one or more spatial values.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 计算坡度、降雨量或分类面积时，像元大小、位置和取值类型直接影响运算结果。
why_it_matters.en: Slope, rainfall, and classified-area calculations depend on cell size, alignment, and what each value means.

fresh_take.en: A grid of tiny answers.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 地图切成格子，答案藏在每格里。

translation_note.en: Raster cell and image pixel can overlap in usage, but cell emphasizes grid-based spatial data.
translation_note.zh-Hans: Cell 通常指栅格网格单元；Pixel 更常指图像像素，GIS 中具体语境可重叠。

definition.en: A marker that a raster cell has no valid measurement.
definition.zh-Hans: 表示栅格像元没有有效观测值的标记。

plain.en: A blank patch can mean no observation rather than zero.
plain.zh-Hans: 空白可能表示没有数据，而不是数值为零。

example.en: Exclude NoData cells when calculating average slope.
example.zh-Hans: 计算平均坡度时排除无数据像元。

misconception.en: NoData and zero are not interchangeable.
misconception.zh-Hans: 无数据和数字零不能混淆。

essence.zh-Hans: NoData 表示缺少有效观测，不能被当成数值零。
essence.en: NoData means an absent valid observation, not a numeric zero.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 平均高程或污染浓度的计算如果把缺失值误作零，会使统计结果系统性偏低。
why_it_matters.en: Treating missing elevation or concentration readings as zero can bias averages downward.

fresh_take.en: Missing is not zero.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 空白不是零，是“我不知道”。

translation_note.en: NoData marks invalid or absent raster values; it is not numeric zero or always equivalent to a database NULL.
translation_note.zh-Hans: NoData 是数据有效性标记，不能直接视为数字零，也不总等价于数据库中的 NULL。

definition.en: A reference framework connecting coordinates to positions on Earth.
definition.zh-Hans: 将坐标与地球实际位置联系起来的参考框架。

plain.en: Different datums may assign different numbers to the same place.
plain.zh-Hans: 同一个位置采用不同基准，坐标数值可能不同。

example.en: Convert survey coordinates between reference systems.
example.zh-Hans: 转换测量坐标所使用的基准。

misconception.en: Relabeling coordinates is not a transformation.
misconception.zh-Hans: 修改坐标参考标签不等于做了坐标变换。

essence.zh-Hans: 大地基准把坐标数字固定到确定的地球参考框架。
essence.en: A geodetic datum ties coordinate values to a defined Earth reference framework.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 叠加不同测绘年代或坐标基准的数据时，若忽略基准差异，地物可能发生系统性偏移。
why_it_matters.en: Combining surveys with different datums without transformation can systematically displace otherwise valid positions.

fresh_take.en: The reference Earth matters.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 参照的地球一换，坐标可能就变了。

translation_note.en: A geodetic datum is a geodetic reference framework, not a map projection, and is distinct from a vertical datum.
translation_note.zh-Hans: Geodetic Datum 指水平或大地参考框架，不等于 Map Projection；应与 Vertical Datum（高程基准）区分。

definition.en: A smooth mathematical approximation of Earth's shape used in geodesy.
definition.zh-Hans: 大地测量中用来近似地球形状的光滑数学曲面。

plain.en: It is easier to calculate on a smooth ellipsoid than on uneven terrain.
plain.zh-Hans: 真实地球高低不平，计算时常借助规则椭球。

example.en: Use an ellipsoid in geodetic coordinate calculations.
example.zh-Hans: 使用参考椭球开展大地坐标计算。

misconception.en: The ellipsoid is not the physical mean sea-level surface.
misconception.zh-Hans: 椭球不是实际平均海平面。

essence.zh-Hans: 参考椭球以可计算的规则曲面近似地球整体形状。
essence.en: A reference ellipsoid approximates Earth's shape with a mathematically manageable surface.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 经纬度定位和大地测量计算需要明确椭球参数；它与真实地形和大地水准面不是同一个表面。
why_it_matters.en: Geodetic coordinates depend on ellipsoid parameters; the ellipsoid is neither physical terrain nor the geoid.

fresh_take.en: A smoother Earth for the mathematics.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 先把地球想得规整，坐标才好算。

translation_note.en: A reference ellipsoid is mathematical and is not the same surface as the gravity-defined geoid.
translation_note.zh-Hans: Reference Ellipsoid 是规则数学曲面，不能直接译成大地水准面。

definition.en: An equipotential surface of Earth's gravity field approximating mean sea level.
definition.zh-Hans: 地球重力场的等位面，在理想条件下近似平均海平面。

plain.en: Gravity differences make the geoid unlike a smooth ellipsoid.
plain.zh-Hans: 重力有差异，大地水准面不会像椭球那样规则。

example.en: Convert ellipsoidal heights using a geoid model.
example.zh-Hans: 使用大地水准面模型进行高程转换。

misconception.en: The geoid is a reference surface, not the shape of waves.
misconception.zh-Hans: 大地水准面是参考曲面，而非海浪形状。

essence.zh-Hans: 大地水准面提供与地球重力有关的高程参考。
essence.en: The geoid provides a gravity-related reference surface for heights.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 将 GNSS 的椭球高用于工程高程时，需要适当的大地水准面模型和统一的高程基准。
why_it_matters.en: Using GNSS ellipsoidal heights in engineering often requires a suitable geoid model and consistent height datum.

fresh_take.en: Level is a question of gravity.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 海面看似平，重力让“平”很讲究。

translation_note.en: The geoid is gravity-related, not the reference ellipsoid or the visible wavy sea surface.
translation_note.zh-Hans: 大地水准面近似平均海平面并与重力相关，不应与参考椭球或真实波浪表面混淆。

definition.en: A reference for heights and depths.
definition.zh-Hans: 表示高度与深度所依赖的垂直参考基准。

plain.en: An elevation needs an identified vertical zero.
plain.zh-Hans: 说一个地方高程 30 米，还得知道零点在哪里。

example.en: Compare flood elevations after aligning their datums.
example.zh-Hans: 统一基准后比较洪水水位。

misconception.en: Do not mix heights from different datums without conversion.
misconception.zh-Hans: 不同高程基准的高度不能不经转换直接比较。

essence.zh-Hans: 高程基准规定了高度或深度从哪里开始计算。
essence.en: A vertical datum defines the reference from which height or depth is measured.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 防洪水位、道路标高或建筑高度的比较必须先对齐垂直基准，否则相同数字可能表达不同高度。
why_it_matters.en: Flood levels, roads, and surveyed elevations must share a vertical reference before their values can be safely compared.

fresh_take.en: Height starts with a defined zero.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 高度先要说清零点。

translation_note.en: Esri documents use 高程基准. A vertical datum is a component of a vertical CRS, not the complete coordinate system.
translation_note.zh-Hans: 「高程基准」是 Esri 官方中文文档中的标题；垂直基准可能服务于高度或深度。它是垂直坐标系的一部分，不等于整个坐标系。

definition.en: A numeric identifier for a registered geodetic parameter item, often a CRS.
definition.zh-Hans: 大地测量参数注册库中的数值标识，经常用于标识坐标参考系统。

plain.en: EPSG:4326 refers to a WGS 84 geographic CRS.
plain.zh-Hans: EPSG:4326 指代常见的 WGS 84 地理坐标参考系统。

example.en: Identify a layer CRS by its EPSG code.
example.zh-Hans: 使用 EPSG 代码确认图层的 CRS。

misconception.en: A code does not resolve every software axis-order convention.
misconception.zh-Hans: 代码本身不能消除软件之间的坐标轴顺序差异。

essence.zh-Hans: EPSG 代码是查找坐标参考对象的标识符，不是坐标值。
essence.en: An EPSG code identifies a registered geodetic object; it is not itself a coordinate.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 交流数据时使用统一代码便于识别 CRS，但还要确认轴顺序、单位和软件采用的坐标约定。
why_it_matters.en: Registry IDs simplify CRS exchange, but applications still need to agree on axes, units, and coordinate conventions.

fresh_take.en: An ID for a reference framework.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 给坐标参考系一个可查的身份证号。

translation_note.en: EPSG identifiers can reference more than CRSs; the formal axes of EPSG:4326 are latitude then longitude.
translation_note.zh-Hans: EPSG 代码既可标识 CRS，也可标识其他大地测量参数对象；例如 EPSG:4326 的注册轴顺序为纬度、经度。

definition.en: A zoned projected coordinate system based on transverse Mercator projection.
definition.zh-Hans: 按经度分带、采用横轴墨卡托投影的一套投影坐标系统。

plain.en: Within a suitable zone, coordinates are usually measured in meters.
plain.zh-Hans: 在合适的分带范围内，通常可以使用米制坐标。

example.en: Measure a local hiking trail with an appropriate UTM zone.
example.zh-Hans: 用合适的 UTM 带测量本地徒步路线。

misconception.en: One UTM zone is not ideal for a map spanning many zones.
misconception.zh-Hans: 跨多个分带的广域地图不宜简单使用某一个 UTM 带。

essence.zh-Hans: UTM 通过分带的横轴墨卡托系统提供适于区域测量的平面坐标。
essence.en: UTM uses zoned transverse Mercator coordinate systems for regional mapping.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 在合适分带内量测道路长度通常比直接拿经纬度角度计算更合理；跨带分析则需要额外考虑。
why_it_matters.en: Within a suitable zone, meter-based measurements are more appropriate than raw degrees; cross-zone work needs extra care.

fresh_take.en: Measure the world one zone at a time.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 地球太宽，就分带细细量。

translation_note.en: UTM denotes a family of zoned projected coordinate systems, not a single global projected CRS.
translation_note.zh-Hans: UTM 更准确地指分带构成的投影坐标系统，而非不分带的单一投影。

definition.en: A projected coordinate system commonly used for tiled web maps.
definition.zh-Hans: 瓦片 Web 地图常用的一种投影坐标系统。

plain.en: It makes seamless zooming through global tiles convenient.
plain.zh-Hans: 它方便把全球地图切成统一瓦片并连续缩放。

example.en: Display a tiled basemap in a browser.
example.zh-Hans: 在浏览器中展示地图瓦片底图。

misconception.en: Distance and area are distorted, especially at high latitudes.
misconception.zh-Hans: 距离和面积存在变形，尤其在高纬度明显。

essence.zh-Hans: Web 墨卡托优先解决全球瓦片地图的展示与缩放一致性。
essence.en: Web Mercator prioritizes consistent tiled display and zooming on the web.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 它适合作在线底图，却会造成面积和距离变形；严肃量测不应因为坐标单位是米就直接采用。
why_it_matters.en: It excels for web basemaps, but its distortions make naive area or distance measurement misleading.

fresh_take.en: Convenient online, distorted on Earth.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 屏幕上很顺手，地球上未必公平。

translation_note.en: Web Mercator is convenient for web maps; its meter-based map coordinates do not imply globally accurate ground measurements.
translation_note.zh-Hans: Web Mercator 常用于在线底图，显示坐标以米表示，但大范围面积、距离计算会受投影变形影响。

definition.en: An operation converting coordinates between reference systems.
definition.zh-Hans: 将坐标从一个参考系统转换到另一个参考系统的操作。

plain.en: Misaligned layers may need correct coordinate transformation.
plain.zh-Hans: 两个图层叠不齐，可能需要正确进行坐标变换。

example.en: Transform survey points to a project CRS.
example.zh-Hans: 把测量点转换到项目使用的坐标参考系统。

misconception.en: Assigning a CRS is not the same as transforming coordinates.
misconception.zh-Hans: 指定 CRS 和变换实际坐标值不是同一件事。

essence.zh-Hans: 坐标变换将同一地点的位置从一个参考系统正确转换到另一个系统。
essence.en: Coordinate transformation expresses the same location in another reference system.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 不同 CRS 的测量成果需要对齐时，应转换坐标值，而不是简单替换坐标系标签。
why_it_matters.en: To align survey data across reference systems, transform coordinate values rather than merely changing a label.

fresh_take.en: One place, a new coordinate language.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 同一个地点，换一套坐标语言来讲。

translation_note.en: Transformation can mean datum-specific operations in some products; this entry covers coordinate operations between reference systems.
translation_note.zh-Hans: Transformation 在不同软件文档中有时特指基准变换；这里采用广义的跨参考系统坐标运算，不应把重标记当成变换。

definition.en: A spatial overlay operation retaining the geometry shared by input datasets.
definition.zh-Hans: 空间叠加运算，保留输入数据彼此重叠的几何部分。

plain.en: Keep only where two sets of shapes overlap.
plain.zh-Hans: 把两层地图叠起来，只留下它们共同覆盖的部分。

example.en: Find farmland within flood-risk zones.
example.zh-Hans: 找出洪水风险区内的耕地。

misconception.en: Intersect may split features and combine attributes; it is not just visual highlighting.
misconception.zh-Hans: 相交可能拆分要素并合并属性，并非简单的视觉高亮。

essence.zh-Hans: 相交叠加保留多个图层共同覆盖的几何区域及相关信息。
essence.en: Intersect overlay retains the geometry and associated information shared by inputs.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 识别洪水区内的农田或保护区内的道路时，它能直接找出同时符合两个空间条件的位置。
why_it_matters.en: It identifies locations meeting two spatial conditions at once, such as farmland inside flood zones.

fresh_take.en: Only where both are present.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 只有双方都到场的地方，才留下来。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Intersect 是 GIS 叠加运算，输出相交的几何与属性关系，不同于仅判断 intersects 谓词是否为真。
translation_note.en: Intersect is an overlay operation; the intersects predicate is a Boolean spatial relationship test.

definition.en: A polygon overlay operation preserving all areas from the inputs and their attribute combinations.
definition.zh-Hans: 保留输入面要素所有覆盖区域及其属性组合的叠加运算。

plain.en: The output distinguishes overlap and non-overlap from both polygon layers.
plain.zh-Hans: 两层面数据联合起来，连只有一边覆盖的区域也会保留。

example.en: Combine soil and land-use polygons for a planning study.
example.zh-Hans: 联合土壤和土地利用面数据开展规划分析。

misconception.en: This GIS overlay is not the same as simply merging files into one dataset.
misconception.zh-Hans: 这里的 Union 并不等于把两个文件直接合并。

essence.zh-Hans: 联合叠加保留输入面图层的全部覆盖区域，并区分它们的重叠关系。
essence.en: Union overlay keeps the full area covered by input polygons and distinguishes their overlaps.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 比较用地规划与土壤类型时，不仅要看重叠，也需要保留仅被一层覆盖的区域。
why_it_matters.en: When comparing land plans and soil types, analysts need both shared areas and areas represented by only one layer.

fresh_take.en: Not just shared ground; all ground.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 交集不够，还要把各自的地盘都算上。

translation_note.en: Esri translates the overlay tool Union as 联合; it is distinct from appending two datasets.
translation_note.zh-Hans: ArcGIS Union 工具官方译为「联合」，属于面叠加分析；它并非把两个矢量文件直接追加到一起。

definition.en: An operation merging adjacent or overlapping features according to shared attribute values or rules.
definition.zh-Hans: 按照共同属性或规则，将相邻或重叠要素合并的处理。

plain.en: District boundaries can be combined into larger regions.
plain.zh-Hans: 多个相邻行政区可以融合成一个更大的区域。

example.en: Dissolve counties by province to produce provincial outlines.
example.zh-Hans: 按所属省份融合县级边界。

misconception.en: Dissolving does not guarantee preserving each original feature's identity.
misconception.zh-Hans: 融合后通常不再保留每个原始要素的独立几何。

essence.zh-Hans: 融合按共同属性或指定规则去掉要素间不再需要的边界。
essence.en: Dissolve removes unnecessary boundaries between features grouped by a shared rule.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 按省份汇总县级多边形时，它能把大量小面整理成可用于区域统计的大面。
why_it_matters.en: It converts many local polygons into larger reporting regions, such as counties dissolved into provinces.

fresh_take.en: Individual borders give way to a group.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 原来按人头算，现在按团队画边界。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Dissolve 常译为「融合」，与 Union（联合叠加）不同：它按属性或规则合并边界。
translation_note.en: Dissolve combines features by a grouping rule; it is not the same as polygon Union overlay.

definition.en: An overlay operation removing input areas covered by erase features.
definition.zh-Hans: 从输入几何中去掉被擦除要素覆盖的部分。

plain.en: Cut out restricted regions from candidate land.
plain.zh-Hans: 从候选地块里剔除禁止开发区域。

example.en: Remove wetlands from available construction land.
example.zh-Hans: 从可开发土地中排除湿地区域。

misconception.en: Erase changes output geometry; it does not delete source files by default.
misconception.zh-Hans: 擦除生成新几何，不等于删除源文件。

essence.zh-Hans: 擦除从候选区域中扣除被排除范围覆盖的部分。
essence.en: Erase subtracts excluded areas from a candidate geometry.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 可建设用地评估时，可以从初始候选地块中扣除湿地、禁建区等限制范围。
why_it_matters.en: Site suitability work can subtract wetlands and restricted land from candidate development areas.

fresh_take.en: Keep the eligible remainder.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 画完候选区，再把不允许的划掉。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Erase 是从输入几何扣除重叠部分的空间分析，不等同于删除原始数据。
translation_note.en: Erase subtracts geometry from an output; it need not delete input datasets.

definition.en: A family of operations combining datasets based on geometric overlap and spatial relationships.
definition.zh-Hans: 依据几何重叠或空间关系组合数据集的一类分析。

plain.en: Put two thematic maps together to see where their conditions coincide.
plain.zh-Hans: 两种专题数据放在一起，看哪些地方同时满足条件。

example.en: Combine flood hazards and population distribution.
example.zh-Hans: 叠加洪水危险区和人口分布。

misconception.en: Overlay is a family of methods, not a single universal algorithm.
misconception.zh-Hans: 叠加是方法家族，并非唯一一种算法。

essence.zh-Hans: 空间叠加通过几何关系组合数据，从而回答条件在哪些位置同时成立。
essence.en: Spatial overlay combines datasets through geometry to find where conditions coincide.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 风险评估常需要交叉考虑地形、人口和土地利用，单独看任何一个图层都不够。
why_it_matters.en: Risk assessment often needs terrain, population, and land-use conditions considered together rather than in isolation.

fresh_take.en: Two layers answer one location question.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 让两个图层在同一个地方交出答案。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Spatial Overlay 是空间分析方法族，包含 Intersect、Union、Erase 等，不能狭义译为某一个具体工具。
translation_note.en: Spatial overlay is a family of geometric combinations, not any one tool.

definition.en: Analysis of distances or nearby relationships among spatial features.
definition.zh-Hans: 分析空间要素之间距离或邻近关系的方法。

plain.en: Nearness can be measured as straight-line distance or along networks.
plain.zh-Hans: “附近”可以指直线近，也可以指沿道路走得近。

example.en: Find clinics within a walkable distance of homes.
example.zh-Hans: 寻找住宅步行可达的诊所。

misconception.en: Straight-line distance is not automatically travel distance.
misconception.zh-Hans: 直线距离不等于实际道路行程距离。

essence.zh-Hans: 邻近分析关注空间对象相距多远，以及怎样定义“近”。
essence.en: Proximity analysis studies how near objects are and what measurement makes them near.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 选医院或消防站时，直线距离与实际通行距离可能给出不同结果，必须选对度量方式。
why_it_matters.en: Hospital or fire-station placement can change dramatically depending on straight-line versus network distance.

fresh_take.en: Near on paper is not always near by road.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 看着近，不一定走着近。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 邻近分析需要指定距离的度量：平面距离、测地线距离或网络行程距离可能得出不同结论。
translation_note.en: Proximity depends on the chosen metric: planar, geodesic, or network travel distance.

definition.en: A spatial test determining whether a point lies within or on the boundary of a polygon according to a chosen predicate.
definition.zh-Hans: 按照指定空间谓词，判断点是否位于面内部或边界的操作。

plain.en: Check which district contains a given school.
plain.zh-Hans: 判断某所学校位于哪个行政区。

example.en: Assign each monitoring station to a watershed.
example.zh-Hans: 将监测站归属到对应流域。

misconception.en: Points on boundaries may be treated differently by different predicates.
misconception.zh-Hans: 边界点在 contains 与 covers 等谓词下结果可能不同。

essence.zh-Hans: 点在面内判断用空间谓词确定一个位置与区域边界的关系。
essence.en: Point-in-polygon tests a location against a polygon using a chosen spatial predicate.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 将学校分配到行政区或监测站归属到流域时，这种判断是后续汇总统计的基础。
why_it_matters.en: Assigning schools to districts or gauges to watersheds depends on correctly testing their polygon membership.

fresh_take.en: A point asks which area it belongs to.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 点虽小，也得问它属于谁家。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 点在面内不代表所有边界情形都算「包含」；contains、covers、within 等谓词的边界规则不同。
translation_note.en: Point-in-polygon needs an explicit boundary rule; contains, covers, and within differ on boundaries.

definition.en: A data structure that speeds up searching for features by location or geometry.
definition.zh-Hans: 加快按位置和几何查询要素的数据结构。

plain.en: It narrows the candidate features before costly geometry tests.
plain.zh-Hans: 先快速筛掉明显不相关的要素，再进行精细的几何判断。

example.en: Find nearby buildings among millions of features.
example.zh-Hans: 在数百万建筑中快速找到附近的建筑。

misconception.en: An index accelerates access; it does not improve coordinate accuracy.
misconception.zh-Hans: 索引提升查询速度，不会提高位置精度。

essence.zh-Hans: 空间索引先快速缩小候选对象范围，再进行精确几何判断。
essence.en: A spatial index narrows likely candidates before detailed geometry tests.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 百万级地物的邻近搜索和空间连接若没有合适索引，性能可能慢到无法交互使用。
why_it_matters.en: Spatial searches and joins over millions of features often need indexing to remain interactive.

fresh_take.en: Look in the index before searching the whole world.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 先翻地图目录，再找门牌号。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 空间索引是提高空间查询性能的数据结构，与 Spatial Reference（空间参考）概念无关。
translation_note.en: Spatial index speeds up location-based lookup; it is unrelated to a spatial reference system.

definition.en: A method identifying the spatial feature closest to another under a specified distance metric.
definition.zh-Hans: 在给定距离度量下寻找距离某要素最近对象的方法。

plain.en: Find the nearest hospital to a school.
plain.zh-Hans: 寻找距离一所学校最近的医院。

example.en: Find the nearest charging station to each vehicle.
example.zh-Hans: 为每辆车寻找最近的充电站。

misconception.en: Nearest by straight line is not always fastest by road.
misconception.zh-Hans: 直线最近的地点不一定沿道路最快可达。

essence.zh-Hans: 最近邻在确定的距离规则下找出空间上最接近的对象。
essence.en: Nearest-neighbor analysis finds the closest object under an explicit distance rule.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 为车辆匹配最近充电站时，要区分空间直线最近与道路行程最短，否则推荐可能不实用。
why_it_matters.en: Matching vehicles to chargers requires distinguishing geometric closeness from actual network travel cost.

fresh_take.en: Closest does not always mean quickest.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 最亲近的不一定最方便见面。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Nearest Neighbor 要说明距离度量；在路网中最近点可能与直线最近点不同。
translation_note.en: Nearest neighbor depends on the distance model and need not equal nearest network destination.

definition.en: Estimation of values at unsampled locations using measured spatial observations and assumptions.
definition.zh-Hans: 依据已有空间观测和一定假设，估计未观测位置数值的方法。

plain.en: Use temperature readings at stations to estimate a continuous surface.
plain.zh-Hans: 借助多个气象站的温度，估计站点之间的温度分布。

example.en: Create an air-quality surface from monitoring stations.
example.zh-Hans: 由空气质量监测点生成连续分布图。

misconception.en: Interpolation creates estimates, not new direct measurements.
misconception.zh-Hans: 插值结果是估计值，不是新产生的现场观测值。

essence.zh-Hans: 空间插值利用已知位置的观测，估计没有测量的位置。
essence.en: Spatial interpolation estimates values where no observation was collected.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 气温、空气质量和降雨量观测点有限，插值可以形成连续面，但预测区域不能当成实测事实。
why_it_matters.en: Sparse temperature, pollution, or rainfall observations can support a continuous surface, but estimates must not be presented as direct measurements.

fresh_take.en: Known points inform estimates elsewhere.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 已知点说话，未知处先猜；猜得有依据。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 空间插值是估算未采样位置的数值，不同于地图上为绘制而进行的栅格重采样。
translation_note.en: Spatial interpolation estimates unsampled locations and differs from raster resampling for grid alignment.

definition.en: An interpolation method weighting observations more heavily when they are nearer the prediction point.
definition.zh-Hans: 按与待估位置的距离赋权，距离越近通常权重越大的插值方法。

plain.en: Nearby observations generally influence the estimate more.
plain.zh-Hans: 离目标位置越近的观测值，通常越能影响估计结果。

example.en: Estimate rainfall where no gauge is installed.
example.zh-Hans: 估计没有雨量站位置的降雨量。

misconception.en: IDW does not automatically model uncertainty or physical barriers.
misconception.zh-Hans: IDW 不会自动处理预测不确定性或地形阻隔等机制。

essence.zh-Hans: 反距离权重插值让离预测点更近的观测通常拥有更大影响。
essence.en: IDW usually gives nearby observations greater influence over a predicted value.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 站点稀疏时它提供一种直观的连续面估计，但结果对距离幂次、采样分布和障碍物敏感。
why_it_matters.en: IDW is a straightforward interpolation baseline, but its outputs depend on distance power, sampling layout, and barriers.

fresh_take.en: Nearby observations get a louder voice.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 远亲不如近邻，统计也这样想。

translation_note.zh-Hans: ArcGIS 中文工具名为「反距离权重法」，算法常用于插值；也称反距离加权插值（IDW）。
translation_note.en: IDW is commonly called inverse-distance weighted interpolation; both Chinese phrasings are used.

definition.en: A geostatistical family of methods using modeled spatial autocorrelation to predict values at unsampled locations.
definition.zh-Hans: 利用空间自相关模型，对未采样位置进行预测的一类地统计方法。

plain.en: It uses not only proximity but also a modeled pattern of spatial variation.
plain.zh-Hans: 不只考虑距离，还会利用数据的空间相关变化规律。

example.en: Estimate soil contamination between sample sites.
example.zh-Hans: 估计土壤采样点之间的污染程度。

misconception.en: Kriging results depend on model assumptions and sampling quality.
misconception.zh-Hans: 结果取决于变异函数模型、采样质量等条件。

essence.zh-Hans: 克里金利用观测值之间的空间相关结构进行预测。
essence.en: Kriging predicts values using a model of spatial correlation among observations.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 土壤或地下水监测可以借助克里金预测未采样区域，但需要合理的变异函数和误差解释。
why_it_matters.en: Soil and groundwater prediction can benefit from kriging, provided correlation assumptions and uncertainty are assessed.

fresh_take.en: Distance matters, and so does correlation.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 邻居不止离得近，还要看关系有多像。

translation_note.zh-Hans: ArcGIS 中文工具名为「克里金法」，可用于地统计插值；不应把它误当作简单距离加权。
translation_note.en: Kriging is geostatistical and uses a covariance/variogram model, unlike simple distance-weighted averaging.

definition.en: A statistical approach identifying spatial clusters of unusually high or low values under a chosen method.
definition.zh-Hans: 根据选定统计方法，识别高值或低值空间聚集区的分析。

plain.en: Look for locations where high values cluster beyond random expectation.
plain.zh-Hans: 寻找高值集中出现且可能不同于随机分布的区域。

example.en: Analyze clusters of high traffic collision counts.
example.zh-Hans: 分析交通事故高发聚集区域。

misconception.en: A visually red area is not necessarily a statistically significant hot spot.
misconception.zh-Hans: 地图上涂红的区域不一定具有统计显著性。

essence.zh-Hans: 热点分析识别数值在空间上的显著聚集，而不只是画出红色区域。
essence.en: Hot spot analysis looks for statistically meaningful spatial clustering, not merely red-looking areas.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 交通事故或公共卫生风险的热点可帮助资源配置，但必须区分统计显著性与视觉上的高密度。
why_it_matters.en: Collision or health-risk clusters can guide resource allocation when statistical evidence is separated from visual density.

fresh_take.en: A true hot spot needs evidence.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 热闹不算热点，得证明不是巧合。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 统计学意义上的 Hot Spot Analysis 与仅以颜色显示密度的 Heat Map（热力图）不同。
translation_note.en: Statistical hot-spot analysis must be distinguished from a visual heat map or a density surface.

definition.en: Analysis using connected edges and nodes to model travel, flow, or access.
definition.zh-Hans: 利用相互连接的边和节点，研究出行、流动和可达性的分析。

plain.en: Road connectivity determines whether a route can actually be used.
plain.zh-Hans: 道路之间能否连通，决定了是否真的能走到目的地。

example.en: Find the shortest drive to an emergency shelter.
example.zh-Hans: 计算到应急避难所的最短驾驶路径。

misconception.en: A visually touching pair of streets may be disconnected by elevation or restrictions.
misconception.zh-Hans: 道路看起来相交，也可能因立交或限制而无法转向。

essence.zh-Hans: 网络分析在可连通、可通行的边与节点上研究路径和服务范围。
essence.en: Network analysis reasons over connected, traversable edges and nodes.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 计算救援路线时，道路是否真正连通、单行限制与时间成本，比两点间的直线距离更关键。
why_it_matters.en: Emergency routing needs real connectivity, one-way restrictions, and travel costs rather than straight-line proximity.

fresh_take.en: No route without a connection.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 连得上，才谈得上到得了。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Network Analysis 不仅限于道路，也可用于物流、管网和其他有连通性及成本规则的网络。
translation_note.en: Network analysis can model roads, utilities, and any constrained connected system.

definition.en: A route through a connected network minimizing a chosen cost such as length or time.
definition.zh-Hans: 在连通网络中，使距离、时间等指定成本最小的路径。

plain.en: Fastest and shortest are different when traffic conditions vary.
plain.zh-Hans: 路程最短和时间最快，可能是两条不同的路。

example.en: Route an ambulance by estimated travel time.
example.zh-Hans: 按预计通行时间为救护车规划路线。

misconception.en: Shortest requires a specified cost function and valid network restrictions.
misconception.zh-Hans: “最短”必须说明优化的是何种成本，并考虑道路限制。

essence.zh-Hans: 最短路径是在给定网络和成本定义下寻找总代价最小的路线。
essence.en: A shortest path minimizes a specified cost along a valid network.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 通勤导航或配送优化中，“最短”必须明确是距离、时间还是其他成本，不同目标会选出不同路线。
why_it_matters.en: Navigation and delivery must specify whether shortest means distance, time, or another cost before choosing a route.

fresh_take.en: Best requires a definition of cost.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 没有定义代价，就没有唯一的最优。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 最短路径中的「短」由成本函数定义；按时间最短不一定按距离最短。
translation_note.en: Shortest path means minimum specified cost, not necessarily geometric length.

definition.en: Retrieval of data based on geometry or spatial relationships.
definition.zh-Hans: 根据几何或空间关系检索数据的操作。

plain.en: Ask which buildings lie inside a selected district.
plain.zh-Hans: 查询指定行政区内有哪些建筑。

example.en: Select schools intersecting a flood zone.
example.zh-Hans: 选择与洪水区相交的学校要素。

misconception.en: Spatial predicates such as intersects and contains are not interchangeable.
misconception.zh-Hans: 相交、包含等空间谓词不能随意互换。

essence.zh-Hans: 空间查询按位置、距离或几何关系筛选数据，而不仅靠文字条件。
essence.en: A spatial query filters data by location, distance, or geometry rather than just textual attributes.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 可以用一条空间条件快速找出洪水区里的学校，而不用人工逐一核对所有学校位置。
why_it_matters.en: A spatial predicate can find schools in a flood zone without manually checking every school.

fresh_take.en: Ask where before asking what.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 不问叫什么，先问在哪里。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 空间查询按位置或几何关系筛选，不应与只按普通属性字段筛选的 Attribute Query 混用。
translation_note.en: Spatial queries use geometry predicates or location, unlike purely attribute-based queries.

definition.en: The theory and practice of designing, making, and interpreting maps.
definition.zh-Hans: 研究地图设计、制作与使用的一门学科与实践。

plain.en: Color, symbol, scale and hierarchy influence what readers notice.
plain.zh-Hans: 颜色、符号、比例尺和视觉层级决定读者看到什么。

example.en: Design a clear election-results map.
example.zh-Hans: 设计一幅易读的选举统计地图。

misconception.en: A visually attractive map is not necessarily accurate or unbiased.
misconception.zh-Hans: 好看的地图不一定准确，也可能误导读者。

essence.zh-Hans: 地图制图学把数据、视觉表达和读者理解组织成有效的地理沟通。
essence.en: Cartography brings data, visual design, and interpretation together for geographic communication.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 同样的数据可能因为符号、比例尺和分类不同而造成相反的印象，制图选择直接影响决策。
why_it_matters.en: The same data can feel different under different symbols, scales, and classes, so cartographic choices affect decisions.

fresh_take.en: How you draw data shapes the story.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 同样的数据，画法决定故事怎么讲。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Cartography 通常对应「地图制图学」或「制图学」，强调地图制作与沟通，不等同于 GIS 的全部范围。
translation_note.en: Cartography concerns maps and map communication and does not encompass all GIS functions.

definition.en: Rules for representing geographic features using visual symbols.
definition.zh-Hans: 用点、线、面及视觉变量表现地理要素的规则。

plain.en: Thicker lines can emphasize major highways.
plain.zh-Hans: 粗线能强调高速公路的重要性。

example.en: Color parks green and railways black in a city map.
example.zh-Hans: 在城市地图中用绿色表示公园、黑色表示铁路。

misconception.en: Symbol size or color must have a clear, defensible meaning.
misconception.zh-Hans: 符号的大小和颜色应该有清楚且合理的含义。

essence.zh-Hans: 符号化决定地理要素如何通过颜色、形状、大小等视觉变量被识别。
essence.en: Symbology turns features into recognizable visual marks using color, shape, size, and other variables.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 风险等级、道路类型或设施重要性若没有合理的视觉编码，地图就容易产生歧义。
why_it_matters.en: Hazard levels, road classes, and facility priorities are easy to misread without consistent visual encoding.

fresh_take.en: Same data, different visual emphasis.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 数据没变，换个符号，读者可能换个判断。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Symbology 在 GIS 中是地图符号与视觉编码配置，不等同于图层所承载的实际空间数据。
translation_note.en: Symbology controls map representation, not the underlying geographic records.

definition.en: A thematic map coloring geographic areas according to values or classes.
definition.zh-Hans: 按区域属性数值或分级使用颜色表达的专题地图。

plain.en: Counties are shaded according to a rate or proportion.
plain.zh-Hans: 按照某项比率给不同区县着色。

example.en: Map population density by administrative area.
example.zh-Hans: 按行政区展示人口密度。

misconception.en: Raw counts can mislead when polygon sizes or populations differ.
misconception.zh-Hans: 各区人口规模差异大时，直接用总量设色容易误导。

essence.zh-Hans: 分级设色图使用区域颜色表达一个属性的数值分布。
essence.en: A choropleth map uses area colors to show the geographic distribution of a variable.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 比较各县的发病率通常比比较病例总数更合适，否则人口多的地方会显得天然更危险。
why_it_matters.en: Rates often make fairer county comparisons than raw case counts, which tend to reflect population size.

fresh_take.en: Darker does not always mean worse.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 颜色越深不等于问题越严重，先看分母。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Choropleth 适合表达归一化后的区域比率或密度；原始总量常需额外解释比较条件。
translation_note.en: Choropleths often communicate rates or densities more fairly than raw totals when areas differ.

definition.en: Grouping numeric values into classes for mapping or analysis.
definition.zh-Hans: 根据规则将数值划分成多个等级，便于地图表达或分析。

plain.en: A map may show five ranges instead of every exact income value.
plain.zh-Hans: 收入地图可以用五个等级代替展示每一个精确数字。

example.en: Compare quantile and natural-break classes for unemployment rates.
example.zh-Hans: 比较分位数与自然断点法对失业率地图的影响。

misconception.en: Class boundaries can change the apparent spatial pattern.
misconception.zh-Hans: 分级断点不同，地图呈现的空间格局可能不同。

essence.zh-Hans: 数据分级把连续数值划分成地图可辨认的几个范围。
essence.en: Data classification groups numeric values into a manageable set of mapped ranges.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 分位数与自然断点法可能让同一份数据呈现不同图案，发布专题图时要明确分级方法。
why_it_matters.en: Quantiles and natural breaks can produce different stories from identical data, so the method should be explicit.

fresh_take.en: The breaks change the picture.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 同一组数字，分组方式会改写故事。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 此处的 Data Classification 是制图数值分级，不能误读为遥感 Image Classification（影像分类）。
translation_note.en: This is thematic numeric classing, not remote-sensing image classification.
