definition.en: An identifier distinguishing a feature within a dataset or service.
definition.zh-Hans: 在数据集或服务范围内区分不同要素的标识。

plain.en: A feature ID lets a system refer to a particular road record.
plain.zh-Hans: 要素 ID 使系统能够定位一条具体道路记录。

example.en: Update the attribute of a selected feature by identifier.
example.zh-Hans: 根据标识符更新所选要素属性。

misconception.en: An identifier may be stable only within a defined dataset or lifecycle.
misconception.zh-Hans: 标识符的唯一性和稳定性可能只适用于特定数据集或生命周期。

essence.zh-Hans: 要素标识符为数据集中的某个地理对象提供可识别的身份。
essence.en: A feature identifier gives a particular spatial record an addressable identity.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 更新道路属性或将一条审核意见关联到要素时，必须能稳定找到同一条记录，不能只依赖显示名称。
why_it_matters.en: Edits and review comments need to target the correct record reliably instead of relying on potentially duplicate names.

fresh_take.en: Names repeat; IDs distinguish.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 名字能重复，身份得分清。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 要素标识符的唯一性作用域与稳定性由数据源决定；ArcGIS ObjectID 与全局 GUID 不保证具有同一生命周期语义。
translation_note.en: Feature IDs have dataset-specific stability; ArcGIS ObjectID and global identifiers differ in persistence.

definition.en: Managing successive states of a dataset so changes can be tracked, compared or recovered.
definition.zh-Hans: 管理数据集在不同时间的状态，以便追踪、比较或恢复变更。

plain.en: Editors can preserve a history of changed road features.
plain.zh-Hans: 道路数据可以保留编辑前后的变更记录。

example.en: Review parcel-boundary edits before publishing.
example.zh-Hans: 在发布前审查宗地边界修改。

misconception.en: Versioning does not automatically resolve conflicting edits correctly.
misconception.zh-Hans: 版本管理不会自动保证所有编辑冲突都得到正确处理。

essence.zh-Hans: 数据版本管理记录数据集的修改状态，支持比较与恢复。
essence.en: Data versioning tracks dataset changes so versions can be compared or restored.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 多人协作编辑管线或宗地时，版本记录能帮助回看谁改了什么并控制发布风险，但冲突仍需专门处理。
why_it_matters.en: Collaborative parcel or utility editing benefits from traceable versions, although conflicts still require resolution.

fresh_take.en: A timeline for data changes.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 数据也要有后悔药和时间线。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 这里是数据版本管理的一般概念；ArcGIS 地理数据库的版本化编辑具有更具体的实现规则。
translation_note.en: This is generic dataset version management; ArcGIS geodatabase versioning has its own defined mechanisms.

definition.en: The degree to which data is recent enough for a particular use.
definition.zh-Hans: 数据相对某个应用场景而言是否足够新近。

plain.en: A road map from last year may miss new construction.
plain.zh-Hans: 去年的道路图可能遗漏最近开通的道路。

example.en: Check update dates before routing emergency vehicles.
example.zh-Hans: 为应急车辆规划路线前核查道路更新日期。

misconception.en: Newer data is not necessarily more accurate or complete.
misconception.zh-Hans: 更新的数据不一定比旧数据更准确或更完整。

essence.zh-Hans: 数据时效性判断数据的新旧是否满足当前任务的需要。
essence.en: Data freshness asks whether data is recent enough for the decision at hand.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 道路通车情况和实时风险区比长期稳定的行政区边界更容易过时，不能采用统一的更新频率要求。
why_it_matters.en: Road openings and active hazards age faster than many administrative boundaries, so acceptable update intervals differ by task.

fresh_take.en: Correct but old can still mislead.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 数据再准，过时也可能误事。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 时效性应结合应用决策窗口判断；最新更新日期不保证底层观测同步更新。
translation_note.en: Freshness is task-relative; a recent file modification date does not prove the measurements are current.

definition.en: The degree to which a dataset follows agreed structure, logic and cross-record rules.
definition.zh-Hans: 数据符合约定结构、逻辑和记录间规则的程度。

plain.en: All road classes should use the same coding scheme.
plain.zh-Hans: 道路等级应使用一致的编码规则。

example.en: Find contradictory land-use codes across districts.
example.zh-Hans: 检查各行政区土地利用编码是否冲突。

misconception.en: Consistent data can still be consistently wrong.
misconception.zh-Hans: 数据彼此一致，也可能一致地犯错。

essence.zh-Hans: 数据一致性衡量各记录是否遵循相同的结构与业务规则。
essence.en: Data consistency checks whether records follow shared schemas and business rules.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 多个行政区的数据如果采用不同编码或单位，合并统计会产生隐蔽错误，即使单个文件都能正常打开。
why_it_matters.en: Combining districts that use different codes or units creates hidden analytical errors even when each file opens correctly.

fresh_take.en: Shared rules make data cooperate.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 每条记录说同一种话，才能一起工作。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 数据一致性包含跨记录、编码、单位及几何约束的匹配，不等于数据绝对准确。
translation_note.en: Consistency covers schemas, codes, units, and constraints, and does not imply absolute accuracy.

definition.en: A description or measure of limited confidence in data, measurements or predictions.
definition.zh-Hans: 用于描述数据、测量或预测可信程度有限性的概念或度量。

plain.en: A predicted flood boundary may vary under different model assumptions.
plain.zh-Hans: 洪水预测边界可能随模型假设而改变。

example.en: Present a range of likely flood depths instead of one exact value.
example.zh-Hans: 用可能的水深范围而不是一个确定数值表达风险。

misconception.en: Uncertainty is not the same as a known error or an excuse for poor data.
misconception.zh-Hans: 不确定性不等同于已知误差，也不是数据质量差的借口。

essence.zh-Hans: 不确定性表达对观测、模型或预测结论有多少把握。
essence.en: Uncertainty communicates the limits of confidence in observations, models, or predictions.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 洪水预测或插值结果不应只给一个看似精确的值；合理呈现范围与假设能帮助读者做风险决策。
why_it_matters.en: Flood forecasts and interpolated surfaces should communicate plausible ranges and assumptions rather than false certainty.

fresh_take.en: Knowing the limits of what we know.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 不确定不是不知道，而是知道还有多少没把握。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 不确定性是对误差范围、假设或可信程度的描述，不等同于已经确认的具体错误。
translation_note.en: Uncertainty describes limited confidence or variability, not necessarily a confirmed mistake.

definition.en: Height related to the geoid, commonly interpreted as height above a geoid-based vertical reference.
definition.zh-Hans: 相对于大地水准面等垂直参考曲面表达的高度。

plain.en: A mountain's orthometric height is not the same as its ellipsoidal height.
plain.zh-Hans: 山峰的正高不同于相对于参考椭球的高度。

example.en: Compare surveyed elevations using a consistent height reference.
example.zh-Hans: 在统一高程参考下比较实测高程。

misconception.en: A GNSS receiver may report ellipsoidal height unless transformed.
misconception.zh-Hans: GNSS 接收机可能输出椭球高，需要处理后才能得到正高。

essence.zh-Hans: 正高是相对于大地水准面相关垂直参考的高度。
essence.en: Orthometric height is elevation referenced to a gravity-related surface such as the geoid.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 水利、工程或海拔比较需要统一高程基准；GNSS 输出的椭球高通常不能直接作为正高使用。
why_it_matters.en: Engineering and water-level comparisons need consistent vertical references; GNSS ellipsoidal heights generally require conversion.

fresh_take.en: Height depends on the chosen surface.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 说海拔之前，先问高度相对什么面。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Orthometric Height（正高）通常依托重力相关的大地水准面；不能未经转换就把 GNSS 椭球高当成正高。
translation_note.en: Orthometric height refers to a gravity-related reference; GNSS ellipsoidal heights require a suitable conversion.

definition.en: Height measured along the ellipsoid normal from a reference ellipsoid to a point.
definition.zh-Hans: 沿参考椭球法线，从参考椭球面到目标点的高度。

plain.en: A GNSS-based height often starts from an ellipsoid, not sea level.
plain.zh-Hans: GNSS 测得的高度通常先相对于椭球，而不是平均海平面。

example.en: Use a geoid model to relate ellipsoidal height to orthometric height.
example.zh-Hans: 借助大地水准面模型联系椭球高和正高。

misconception.en: Ellipsoidal height should not be labeled as sea-level elevation without conversion.
misconception.zh-Hans: 未经转换不能直接把椭球高称为海拔。

essence.zh-Hans: 椭球高是点相对于参考椭球沿法线测得的高度。
essence.en: Ellipsoidal height measures height along the normal to a reference ellipsoid.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 使用 GNSS 进行高程测量时，若忽略它与正高的差别，可能出现明显的工程标高偏差。
why_it_matters.en: GNSS-based elevations can be misused in engineering if ellipsoidal heights are confused with orthometric heights.

fresh_take.en: Same mountain, different zero.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 同一座山，换一个零面，数字就不同。

translation_note.zh-Hans: Ellipsoidal Height 在中文也可称「大地高」，相对于参考椭球，不等同于海拔或正高。
translation_note.en: Ellipsoidal height, also called 大地高, is relative to an ellipsoid rather than a geoid-based height datum.

definition.en: The ability of different systems to exchange and correctly use geospatial data or services.
definition.zh-Hans: 不同系统之间交换并正确使用地理空间数据或服务的能力。

plain.en: A standards-based service can be used by different GIS applications.
plain.zh-Hans: 遵循共同标准的服务可被不同 GIS 应用使用。

example.en: Use an OGC API from multiple mapping clients.
example.zh-Hans: 让多个地图客户端访问同一个 OGC API。

misconception.en: Sharing a file does not guarantee both systems interpret its CRS and fields correctly.
misconception.zh-Hans: 能打开同一文件不代表双方正确理解其坐标参考和字段。

essence.zh-Hans: 地理空间互操作性要求不同系统不仅能交换数据，还能正确理解和使用数据。
essence.en: Geospatial interoperability means different systems can exchange and correctly interpret geodata.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: GeoPackage、OGC API 和 CRS 标识让工具间协作更容易，但格式一致并不保证语义、单位与权限一致。
why_it_matters.en: Standards improve cross-tool workflows, but compatible files alone cannot guarantee matching semantics, units, or access rights.

fresh_take.en: Exchange is not enough; understanding matters.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 数据能走出家门，还得让别人听懂。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 互操作性不仅是文件能够打开，还要求坐标轴、语义、编码和服务协议被双方一致理解。
translation_note.en: Interoperability requires shared interpretation of axes, semantics, encodings, and service behavior.

definition.en: Terms specifying permitted use, sharing, modification and redistribution of geographic data.
definition.zh-Hans: 规定地理空间数据使用、共享、修改和再发布条件的许可条款。

plain.en: A public download link does not automatically grant redistribution rights.
plain.zh-Hans: 数据公开下载，并不自动允许复制后重新发布。

example.en: Check satellite image attribution rules before republishing.
example.zh-Hans: 再发布卫星影像前核查署名和授权要求。

misconception.en: Free access is not the same as public domain or open licensing.
misconception.zh-Hans: 免费访问不等于公有领域或开放许可。

essence.zh-Hans: 地理空间数据许可说明数据能够如何使用、修改、传播和署名。
essence.en: A geospatial data license specifies how data may be used, modified, shared, and attributed.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 开放网页上的底图、影像或行政边界并不天然允许打包进应用发布，提前核查许可可避免合规风险。
why_it_matters.en: A publicly viewable map or imagery layer is not automatically reusable in an app; checking license terms avoids legal risk.

fresh_take.en: Accessible does not mean reusable.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 数据能看，不代表能搬走。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 公开访问或免费下载不代表内容处于公有领域；再发布需遵循许可或取得权利人允许。
translation_note.en: Public access or free download does not grant unrestricted redistribution rights.

definition.en: A relationship between geometries such as intersection, containment, proximity or connectivity.
definition.zh-Hans: 几何对象之间的相交、包含、邻近或连通等关系。

plain.en: Two places can be related by where they lie, even if their names share nothing.
plain.zh-Hans: 两个地点即使名字毫无关联，也可能因为位置相交、相邻或包含而建立联系。

example.en: Find schools inside a district or roads crossing a river.
example.zh-Hans: 查找区内学校，或找出穿越河流的道路。

misconception.en: Different spatial predicates have different boundary rules; touches, intersects and contains are not identical.
misconception.zh-Hans: 不同空间谓词对边界有不同判断规则，相接、相交与包含不能混用。

essence.zh-Hans: 空间关系描述地物之间怎样相交、包含、相邻或连通。
essence.en: Spatial relationships describe how features intersect, contain, touch, or connect.

why_it_matters.zh-Hans: 查找洪水区里的学校或跨越河流的道路，都需要准确选定空间谓词，而不是仅凭地图视觉判断。
why_it_matters.en: Finding schools in flood zones or roads crossing rivers requires explicit spatial predicates rather than visual guesswork.

fresh_take.en: Location creates relationships without an introduction.
fresh_take.zh-Hans: 地物不必认识，位置会替它们建立关系。

translation_note.zh-Hans: 空间关系既可指几何相交、包含等空间谓词，也可涉及网络连通；具体语义应结合分析上下文。
translation_note.en: Spatial relationships include geometric predicates and sometimes network connectivity; meaning depends on context.
